analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:913:    <string name="permdesc_acceptHandovers">อนุญาตให้แอปต่อสายที่เริ่มจากแอปอื่น</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:914:    <string name="permdesc_accessCoarseLocation">แอปนี้สามารถรับตำแหน่งของคุณโดยอิงจากแหล่งข้อมูลเครือข่าย เช่น เสาสัญญาณมือถือและเครือข่าย Wi-Fi แอปจะใช้บริการตำแหน่งเหล่านี้ได้ต่อเมื่อคุณเปิดบริการและบริการพร้อมใช้งานในแท็บเล็ตของคุณ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:915:    <string name="permdesc_accessDrmCertificates">ช่วยให้แอปพลิเคชันสามารถจัดสรรและใช้ใบรับรอง DRM ได้ ไม่จำเป็นสำหรับแอปปกติทั่วไป</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:916:    <string name="permdesc_accessFineLocation">แอปนี้สามารถรับตำแหน่งของคุณโดยอิงจากแหล่งข้อมูลเครือข่าย เช่น เสาสัญญาณมือถือและเครือข่าย Wi-Fi แอปจะใช้บริการตำแหน่งเหล่านี้ได้ต่อเมื่อคุณเปิดบริการและบริการพร้อมใช้งานในโทรศัพท์ของคุณ การเปิดบริการนี้อาจเพิ่มการใช้แบตเตอรี่</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:917:    <string name="permdesc_accessImsCallService">อนุญาตให้แอปใช้บริการ IMS เพื่อโทรออกโดยคุณไม่ต้องดำเนินการใดๆ เลย</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:918:    <string name="permdesc_accessLocationExtraCommands">อนุญาตให้แอปเข้าถึงคำสั่งของผู้ให้บริการตำแหน่งเพิ่มเติม ซึ่งอาจทำให้แอปสามารถแทรกแซงการทำงานของ GPS หรือต้นทางของตำแหน่งอื่นๆ ได้</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:919:    <string name="permdesc_accessNetworkConditions">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันฟังข้อสังเกตเกี่ยวกับสภาวะของเครือข่าย ไม่จำเป็นสำหรับแอปปกติ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:920:    <string name="permdesc_accessNetworkState">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันดูข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับการเชื่อมต่อเครือข่าย เช่น มีเครือข่ายใดอยู่บ้าง และมีการเชื่อมต่อเครือข่ายใด</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:921:    <string name="permdesc_accessNotifications">ทำให้แอปสามารถเรียกดู ตรวจสอบ และล้างการแจ้งเตือนได้ ซึ่งรวมถึงการแจ้งเตือนที่โพสต์โดยแอปอื่นๆ ด้วย</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:922:    <string name="permdesc_accessWifiState">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันดูข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับเครือข่าย WiFi เช่น เปิดใช้งาน WiFi อยู่หรือไม่ และชื่อของอุปกรณ์ WiFi ที่เชื่อมต่อ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:923:    <string name="permdesc_accessWimaxState">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันตรวจสอบว่า WiMAX เปิดใช้งานอยู่หรือไม่และข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับเครือข่าย WiMAX ใดๆ ที่เชื่อมต่ออยู่</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:924:    <string name="permdesc_access_notification_policy">อนุญาตให้แอปอ่านและเขียนการกำหนดค่าโหมดห้ามรบกวน</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:925:    <string name="permdesc_addVoicemail">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเพิ่มข้อความลงในกล่องข้อความเสียงของคุณ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:926:    <string name="permdesc_answerPhoneCalls">อนุญาตให้แอปรับสายโทรศัพท์</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:927:    <string name="permdesc_bindCarrierMessagingService">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเชื่อมโยงกับอินเทอร์เฟซระดับบนสุดของบริการรับส่งข้อความของผู้ให้บริการ ไม่ควรใช้สำหรับแอปธรรมดาทั่วไป</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:928:    <string name="permdesc_bindCarrierServices">อนุญาตให้เจ้าของเชื่อมโยงกับบริการของผู้ให้บริการ ไม่ควรต้องใช้สำหรับแอปทั่วไป</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:929:    <string name="permdesc_bindConditionProviderService">อนุญาตให้ผู้ใช้อุปกรณ์เชื่อมโยงกับอินเทอร์เฟซระดับบนสุดของบริการของผู้เสนอเงื่อนไข ไม่จำเป็นสำหรับแอปทั่วไป</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:930:    <string name="permdesc_bindDreamService">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเชื่อมโยงกับอินเทอร์เฟซระดับบนสุดของบริการที่ต้องการ ไม่จำเป็นสำหรับแอปทั่วไป</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:931:    <string name="permdesc_bindNotificationListenerService">อนุญาตให้เจ้าของเชื่อมโยงกับอินเตอร์เฟซระดับสูงสุดของบริการตัวฟังการแจ้งเตือน ซึ่งไม่มีความจำเป็นสำหรับแอปธรรมดา</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:932:    <string name="permdesc_bind_connection_service">อนุญาตให้แอปโต้ตอบกับบริการโทรศัพท์เพื่อโทรออก/รับสาย</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:933:    <string name="permdesc_bind_incall_service">อนุญาตให้แอปควบคุมเวลาและลักษณะที่ผู้ใช้เห็นหน้าจอขณะกำลังใช้สาย</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:934:    <string name="permdesc_bluetooth">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันดูการกำหนดค่าบลูทูธของแท็บเล็ต ตลอดจนเชื่อมต่อและยอมรับการเชื่อมต่อกับอุปกรณ์ที่จับคู่ไว้</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:935:    <string name="permdesc_bluetoothAdmin">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันกำหนดค่าแท็บเล็ตบลูทูธในตัวเครื่อง รวมทั้งค้นหาและจับคู่กับอุปกรณ์ที่อยู่ระยะไกล</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:936:    <string name="permdesc_bodySensors">อนุญาตให้แอปเข้าถึงข้อมูลจากเซ็นเซอร์ที่ตรวจสอบสภาพทางกายภาพ เช่น อัตราการเต้นของหัวใจ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:937:    <string name="permdesc_broadcastSticky">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันส่งการกระจายข้อมูลที่ติดหนึบ ซึ่งจะยังคงอยู่หลังจากการกระจายข้อมูลจบไปแล้ว การใช้งานมากเกินไปอาจทำให้แท็บเล็ตทำงานช้าลงหรือไม่เสถียรโดยการใช้หน่วยความจำมากเกินไป</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:938:    <string name="permdesc_callPhone">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันโทรเข้าโทรศัพท์โดยไม่ต้องให้คุณจัดการ ซึ่งอาจทำให้มีการเรียกเก็บเงินหรือการโทรที่ไม่คาดคิด โปรดทราบว่าการทำงานนี้ไม่ได้อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันโทรไปหมายเลขฉุกเฉิน แอปพลิเคชันที่เป็นอันตรายอาจทำให้คุณต้องเสียค่าบริการด้วยการโทรโดยไม่ขอการยืนยันจากคุณ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:939:    <string name="permdesc_camera">แอปนี้สามารถถ่ายภาพและวิดีโอด้วยกล้องได้ทุกเมื่อ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:940:    <string name="permdesc_changeNetworkState">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเปลี่ยนแปลงสถานะการเชื่อมต่อของเครือข่าย</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:941:    <string name="permdesc_changeTetherState">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเปลี่ยนแปลงสถานะการเชื่อมต่อของเครือข่ายการเชื่อมต่ออินเทอร์เน็ตผ่านมือถือ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:942:    <string name="permdesc_changeWifiMulticastState">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันรับแพ็คเก็ตที่ส่งไปยังทุกอุปกรณ์บนเครือข่าย WiFi โดยใช้ที่อยู่มัลติแคสต์ ไม่ใช่เพียงแท็บเล็ตของคุณเท่านั้น ซึ่งจะใช้พลังงานมากกว่าในโหมดที่ไม่ใช่มัลติแคสต์</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:943:    <string name="permdesc_changeWifiState">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเชื่อมต่อและหยุดเชื่อมต่อจากจุดเข้าใช้งาน WiFi และเปลี่ยนแปลงการกำหนดค่าอุปกรณ์ำสำหรับเครือข่าย WiFi</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:944:    <string name="permdesc_changeWimaxState">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเชื่อมต่อและยกเลิกการเชื่อมต่อแท็บเล็ตกับเครือข่าย WiMAX</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:945:    <string name="permdesc_connection_manager">อนุญาตให้แอปจัดการการเชื่อมต่อโทรคมนาคม</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:946:    <string name="permdesc_control_incall_experience">อนุญาตให้แอปมอบประสบการณ์ของผู้ใช้ขณะกำลังใช้สาย</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:947:    <string name="permdesc_createNetworkSockets">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันสร้างซ็อกเก็ตเครือข่ายและใช้โปรโตคอลเครือข่ายที่กำหนดเอง เบราว์เซอร์และแอปพลิเคชันอื่นๆ ให้วิธีการในการส่งข้อมูลไปยังอินเทอร์เน็ต จึงไม่จำเป็นต้องได้รับการอนุญาตนี้เพื่อที่จะส่งข้อมูลไปยังอินเทอร์เน็ต</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:948:    <string name="permdesc_disableKeyguard">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันปิดใช้งานการล็อกปุ่มกดและการรักษาความปลอดภัยด้วยรหัสผ่านใดๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้อง ตัวอย่างเช่น โทรศัพท์ปิดใช้งานการล็อกปุ่มกดเมื่อรับสายเรียกเข้า จากนั้นจึงเปิดใช้งานการล็อกปุ่มกดใหม่หลังจากวางสาย</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:949:    <string name="permdesc_enableCarMode">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเปิดใช้งานโหมดรถยนต์</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:950:    <string name="permdesc_expandStatusBar">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันขยายหรือยุบแถบสถานะ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:951:    <string name="permdesc_foregroundService">อนุญาตให้แอปใช้ประโยชน์จากบริการที่ใช้งานอยู่</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:952:    <string name="permdesc_getAccounts">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันรับรายการบัญชีที่แท็บเล็ตรู้จัก ซึ่งอาจรวมถึงบัญชีใดๆ ก็ตามที่แอปพลิเคชันซึ่งคุณติดตั้งไว้ได้สร้างขึ้น</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:953:    <string name="permdesc_getPackageSize">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเรียกดูรหัส ข้อมูล และขนาดแคชของตน</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:954:    <string name="permdesc_getTasks">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเรียกดูข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับงานที่ดำเนินการอยู่ในขณะนี้และเมื่อเร็วๆ นี้ ซึ่งอาจทำให้แอปพลิเคชันสามารถค้นข้อมูลได้ว่าอุปกรณ์นี้ใช้แอปพลิเคชันใดบ้าง</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:955:    <string name="permdesc_handoverStatus">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันนี้รับข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับการโอน Android Beam ปัจจุบัน</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:956:    <string name="permdesc_install_shortcut">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเพิ่มทางลัดหน้าจอหลักโดยไม่ต้องให้ผู้ใช้จัดการ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:957:    <string name="permdesc_invokeCarrierSetup">อนุญาตให้ผู้ใช้สามารถเรียกใช้แอปการกำหนดค่าของผู้ให้บริการ ซึ่งแอปทั่วไปไม่จำเป็นต้องใช้</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:958:    <string name="permdesc_killBackgroundProcesses">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันหยุดการทำงานในพื้นหลังของแอปพลิเคชันอื่นๆ ซึ่งอาจทำให้แอปพลิเคชันอื่นๆ หยุดการทำงาน</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:959:    <string name="permdesc_manageFingerprint">อนุญาตให้แอปเรียกใช้วิธีการเพื่อเพิ่มและลบเทมเพลตลายนิ้วมือสำหรับการใช้งาน</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:960:    <string name="permdesc_manageNetworkPolicy">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันจัดการนโยบายเครือข่ายและกำหนดกฎเฉพาะแอปพลิเคชัน</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:961:    <string name="permdesc_manageOwnCalls">อนุญาตให้แอปกำหนดเส้นทางการโทรของแอปผ่านระบบเพื่อปรับปรุงประสบการณ์ในการโทร</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:962:    <string name="permdesc_manageProfileAndDeviceOwners">อนุญาตให้แอปตั้งค่าเจ้าของโปรไฟล์และเจ้าของอุปกรณ์</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:963:    <string name="permdesc_modifyAudioSettings">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันปรับเปลี่ยนการตั้งค่าเสียงทั้งหมดได้ เช่น ระดับเสียงและลำโพงที่จะใช้งาน</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:964:    <string name="permdesc_modifyNetworkAccounting">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันแก้ไขวิธีการบันทึกบัญชีการใช้งานเครือข่ายของแอปพลิเคชัน ไม่ใช้สำหรับแอปพลิเคชันทั่วไป</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:965:    <string name="permdesc_nfc">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันสื่อสารกับแท็ก Near Field Communication (NFC) การ์ด และโปรแกรมอ่าน</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:966:    <string name="permdesc_persistentActivity">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันทำให้ส่วนหนึ่งของตัวเองคงอยู่ถาวรในหน่วยความจำ ซึ่งจะจำกัดพื้นที่หน่วยความจำที่ใช้งานได้ของแอปพลิเคชันอื่นๆ และทำให้แท็บเล็ตทำงานช้าลง</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:967:    <string name="permdesc_processOutgoingCalls">อนุญาตให้แอปดูหมายเลขที่โทรในระหว่างการโทรออกโดยสามารถเลือกเปลี่ยนเส้นทางการโทรไปยังหมายเลขอื่นหรือยกเลิกการโทรไปเลยได้</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:968:    <string name="permdesc_readCalendar">แอปนี้สามารถอ่านกิจกรรมทั้งหมดในปฏิทินที่เก็บไว้ในแท็บเล็ต รวมถึงแชร์หรือบันทึกข้อมูลในปฏิทินของคุณ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:969:    <string name="permdesc_readCallLog">แอปนี้สามารถอ่านประวัติการโทรของคุณได้</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:970:    <string name="permdesc_readCellBroadcasts">อนุญาตให้แอปอ่านข้อความจากสถานีมือถือที่อุปกรณ์ได้รับ การแจ้งเตือนทางมือถือมีให้บริการในบางพื้นที่ โดยจะแจ้งเตือนคุณเกี่ยวกับสถานการณ์ฉุกเฉิน แอปที่เป็นอันตรายอาจเข้าแทรกแซงการทำงานของอุปกรณ์เมื่อได้รับข้อความแจ้งเตือนฉุกเฉิน</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:971:    <string name="permdesc_readContacts">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันอ่านข้อมูลผู้ติดต่อที่จัดเก็บไว้ในแท็บเล็ต ซึ่งรวมถึงความถี่ในการโทร ส่งอีเมล หรือการติดต่อด้วยวิธีอื่นๆ กับบุคคลใดบุคคลหนึ่ง การอนุญาตนี้ทำให้แอปพลิเคชันสามารถบันทึกข้อมูลผู้ติดต่อของคุณ และแอปพลิเคชันที่เป็นอันตรายอาจแชร์ข้อมูลผู้ติดต่อโดยไม่แจ้งให้คุณทราบ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:972:    <string name="permdesc_readHistoryBookmarks">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันอ่านประวัติของ URL ทั้งหมดที่เบราว์เซอร์เคยไป และบุ๊กมาร์กทั้งหมดของเบราว์เซอร์ หมายเหตุ: การอนุญาตนี้อาจไม่สามารถใช้งานได้กับเบราว์เซอร์ของบุคคลที่สามหรือแอปพลิเคชันอื่นๆ ที่มีความสามารถในการเรียกดูบนเว็บ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:973:    <string name="permdesc_readInstallSessions">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันอ่านเซสชันการติดตั้ง ซึ่งจะอนุญาตให้อ่านรายละเอียดเกี่ยวกับการติดตั้งแพ็กเกจที่ใช้งาน</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:974:    <string name="permdesc_readNetworkUsageHistory">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันอ่านประวัติการใช้เครือข่ายสำหรับเครือข่ายและแอปพลิเคชันเฉพาะ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:975:    <string name="permdesc_readPhoneNumbers">อนุญาตให้แอปเข้าถึงหมายเลขโทรศัพท์ของอุปกรณ์นี้</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:976:    <string name="permdesc_readPhoneState">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเข้าถึงฟีเจอร์โทรศัพท์ของอุปกรณ์ การอนุญาตนี้ทำให้แอปพลิเคชันสามารถตรวจสอบหมายเลขโทรศัพท์และรหัสอุปกรณ์ ตรวจสอบว่ามีการโทรที่ทำงานอยู่หรือไม่ และตรวจสอบหมายเลขระยะไกลที่เชื่อมต่อด้วยการโทร</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:977:    <string name="permdesc_readSms">แอปนี้สามารถอ่านข้อความ SMS (ที่เป็นตัวหนังสือ) ที่จัดเก็บไว้ในแท็บเล็ต</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:978:    <string name="permdesc_readSyncSettings">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันอ่านการตั้งค่าการซิงค์ของบัญชี ตัวอย่างเช่น การอนุญาตนี้สามารถระบุได้ว่าแอปพลิเคชัน People ซิงค์กับบัญชีหรือไม่</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:979:    <string name="permdesc_readSyncStats">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันอ่านสถานะการซิงค์ของบัญชี ซึ่งรวมถึงประวัติกิจกรรมการซิงค์และปริมาณข้อมูลที่ซิงค์</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:980:    <string name="permdesc_receiveBootCompleted">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเริ่มต้นตัวเองทันทีที่ระบบบูตเสร็จสิ้น ซึ่งจะทำให้การเริ่มต้นแท็บเล็ตใช้เวลานานกว่าปกติและแอปพลิเคชันจะทำให้การทำงานของแท็บเล็ตโดยรวมช้าลงด้วยการทำงานอยู่ตลอดเวลา</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:981:    <string name="permdesc_receiveMms">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันรับและประมวลผลข้อความ MMS ซึ่งหมายความว่าแอปพลิเคชันจะสามารถตรวจสอบหรือลบข้อความที่ส่งมายังอุปกรณ์ของคุณได้โดยไม่ต้องแสดงให้คุณเห็น</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:982:    <string name="permdesc_receiveSms">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันรับและประมวลผลข้อความ SMS ซึ่งหมายความว่าแอปพลิเคชันจะสามารถตรวจสอบหรือลบข้อความที่ส่งมายังอุปกรณ์ของคุณได้โดยไม่ต้องแสดงให้คุณเห็น</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:983:    <string name="permdesc_receiveWapPush">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันรับและประมวลผลข้อความ WAP การอนุญาตนี้รวมถึงความสามารถในการตรวจสอบหรือลบข้อความที่ส่งมาให้คุณโดยไม่ต้องแสดงให้คุณเห็น</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:984:    <string name="permdesc_recordAudio">แอปนี้สามารถบันทึกเสียงด้วยไมโครโฟนได้ทุกเมื่อ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:985:    <string name="permdesc_register_call_provider">อนุญาตให้แอปลงทะเบียนการเชื่อมต่อโทรคมนาคมใหม่</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:986:    <string name="permdesc_register_sim_subscription">อนุญาตให้แอปลงทะเบียนการเชื่อมต่อซิมโทรคมนาคมใหม่</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:987:    <string name="permdesc_removeDrmCertificates">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันนำใบรับรอง DRM ออก แอปทั่วไปไม่จำเป็นต้องใช้</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:988:    <string name="permdesc_reorderTasks">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันย้ายงานไปยังส่วนหน้าและพื้นหลัง แอปพลิเคชันอาจดำเนินการโดยไม่รอคำสั่งจากคุณ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:989:    <string name="permdesc_requestDeletePackages">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันขอการลบแพ็กเกจ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:990:    <string name="permdesc_requestIgnoreBatteryOptimizations">อนุญาตให้แอปขอสิทธิ์เพิกเฉยต่อการเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพแบตเตอรี่สำหรับแอปนั้น</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:991:    <string name="permdesc_requestInstallPackages">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันขอการติดตั้งแพ็กเกจ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:992:    <string name="permdesc_route_media_output">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันกำหนดเส้นทางเอาต์พุตของสื่อไปยังอุปกรณ์ภายนอกอื่นๆ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:993:    <string name="permdesc_runInBackground">แอปนี้สามารถทำงานในพื้นหลัง ซึ่งอาจทำให้แบตเตอรี่หมดเร็วขึ้น</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:994:    <string name="permdesc_sdcardRead">อนุญาตให้แอปอ่านเนื้อหาในการ์ด SD</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:995:    <string name="permdesc_sdcardWrite">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเขียนลงบนการ์ด SD</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:996:    <string name="permdesc_sendSms">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันส่งข้อความ SMS ซึ่งอาจทำให้มีการเรียกเก็บเงินที่ไม่คาดคิด แอปพลิเคชันที่เป็นอันตรายอาจทำให้คุณเสียค่าใช้จ่ายด้วยการส่งข้อความโดยไม่รอการยืนยันจากคุณ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:997:    <string name="permdesc_setAlarm">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันตั้งเวลาปลุกในแอปพลิเคชันนาฬิกาปลุกที่ติดตั้ง แอปพลิเคชันนาฬิกาปลุกบางรายการอาจไม่ใช้ฟีเจอร์นี้</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:998:    <string name="permdesc_setInputCalibration">อนุญาตให้แอปสามารถปรับพารามิเตอร์การเทียบมาตรฐานของหน้าจอสัมผัส ไม่ควรใช้สำหรับแอปทั่วไป</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:999:    <string name="permdesc_setTimeZone">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเปลี่ยนแปลงเขตเวลาของแท็บเล็ต</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1000:    <string name="permdesc_setWallpaper">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันตั้งค่าวอลเปเปอร์ระบบ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1001:    <string name="permdesc_setWallpaperHints">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันตั้งค่าคำแนะนำขนาดวอลเปเปอร์ของระบบ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1002:    <string name="permdesc_sim_communication">อนุญาตให้แอปส่งคำสั่งไปยัง SIM ซึ่งอันตรายมาก</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1003:    <string name="permdesc_statusBar">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันปิดใช้งานแถบสถานะหรือเพิ่มและนำไอคอนระบบออก</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1004:    <string name="permdesc_statusBarService">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเป็นแถบสถานะ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1005:    <string name="permdesc_subscribedFeedsRead">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันดูรายละเอียดเกี่ยวกับฟีดที่ซิงค์ไว้ในปัจจุบัน</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1006:    <string name="permdesc_systemAlertWindow">แอปนี้สามารถปรากฏเหนือแอปอื่นๆ หรือส่วนอื่นของหน้าจอ ซึ่งอาจรบกวนการใช้งานตามปกติของแอปและทำให้ลักษณะการแสดงแอปอื่นๆ เปลี่ยนไป</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1007:    <string name="permdesc_transmitIr">อนุญาตให้แอปใช้ตัวส่งสัญญาณอินฟราเรดของแท็บเล็ต</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1008:    <string name="permdesc_uninstall_shortcut">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันลบทางลัดหน้าจอหลักโดยไม่ต้องให้ผู้ใช้จัดการ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1009:    <string name="permdesc_useBiometric">อนุญาตให้แอปใช้ฮาร์ดแวร์ชีวมิติเพื่อตรวจสอบสิทธิ์</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1010:    <string name="permdesc_useDataInBackground">แอปนี้สามารถใช้เน็ตในพื้นหลัง ซึ่งอาจเพิ่มปริมาณการใช้อินเทอร์เน็ต</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1011:    <string name="permdesc_useFingerprint">อนุญาตให้แอปใช้ฮาร์ดแวร์ลายนิ้วมือเพื่อตรวจสอบสิทธิ์</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1012:    <string name="permdesc_use_sip">อนุญาตให้แอปโทรและรับสาย SIP</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1013:    <string name="permdesc_vibrate">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันควบคุมการสั่นเตือน</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1014:    <string name="permdesc_wakeLock">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันป้องกันไม่ให้แท็บเล็ตเข้าสู่โหมดสลีป</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1015:    <string name="permdesc_writeCalendar">แอปนี้สามารถเพิ่ม นำออก หรือเปลี่ยนกิจกรรมในปฏิทินบนแท็บเล็ตของคุณ แอปนี้สามารถส่งข้อความที่ดูเหมือนว่ามาจากเจ้าของปฏิทิน หรือเปลี่ยนแปลงกิจกรรมโดยไม่แจ้งให้เจ้าของทราบ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1016:    <string name="permdesc_writeCallLog">อนุญาตให้แอปแก้ไขประวัติการโทรจากแท็บเล็ตของคุณ รวมถึงข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับสายเรียกเข้าและการโทรออก แอปที่เป็นอันตรายอาจใช้สิ่งนี้เพื่อลบหรือแก้ไขประวัติการโทรของคุณ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1017:    <string name="permdesc_writeContacts">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเปลี่ยนแปลงข้อมูลผู้ติดต่อที่จัดเก็บไว้ในแท็บเล็ต ซึ่งรวมถึงความถี่ในการโทร ส่งอีเมล หรือการติดต่อด้วยวิธีอื่นๆ กับบุคคลใดบุคคลหนึ่ง การอนุญาตนี้ทำให้แอปพลิเคชันสามารถลบข้อมูลผู้ติดต่อได้</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1018:    <string name="permdesc_writeGeolocationPermissions">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันแก้ไขการอนุญาตตำแหน่งทางภูมิศาสตร์ของเบราว์เซอร์ แอปพลิเคชันที่เป็นอันตรายอาจใช้การอนุญาตนี้ในการส่งข้อมูลตำแหน่งไปยังเว็บไซต์ต่างๆ ได้ตามต้องการ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1019:    <string name="permdesc_writeHistoryBookmarks">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเปลี่ยนแปลงประวัติหรือบุ๊กมาร์กของเบราว์เซอร์ที่จัดเก็บไว้ในแท็บเล็ต ซึ่งทำให้แอปพลิเคชันสามารถลบหรือเปลี่ยนข้อมูลเบราว์เซอร์ได้ หมายเหตุ: การอนุญาตนี้อาจไม่สามารถใช้งานได้กับเบราว์เซอร์ของบุคคลที่สามหรือแอปพลิเคชันอื่นๆ ที่มีความสามารถในการเรียกดูบนเว็บ</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1020:    <string name="permdesc_writeSettings">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันแก้ไขข้อมูลการตั้งค่าของระบบ แอปพลิเคชันที่เป็นอันตรายอาจทำให้การกำหนดค่าระบบของคุณเสียหาย</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-th/strings.xml:1021:    <string name="permdesc_writeSyncSettings">อนุญาตให้แอปพลิเคชันเปลี่ยนแปลงการตั้งค่าการซิงค์ของบัญชี ตัวอย่างเช่น สามารถใช้การอนุญาตเปิดใช้งานการซิงค์แอปพลิเคชัน People กับบัญชี</string>

analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:191:    <string name="bugreport_option_full_summary">Gamitin ang opsyong ito para sa kaunting pagkaantala sa system kapag hindi tumutugon o masyadong mabagal ang iyong device, o kapag kailangan mo ang lahat ng seksyon ng ulat. analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:913:    <string name="permdesc_acceptHandovers">Pinapayagan ang app na ipagpatuloy ang isang tawag na sinimulan sa ibang app.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:914:    <string name="permdesc_accessCoarseLocation">Makukuha ng app na ito ang iyong lokasyon batay sa mga pinagmulan ng network gaya ng mga cell tower at Wi-Fi network. Ang mga serbisyo ng lokasyon na ito ay dapat naka-on at available sa iyong tablet para sa app upang magamit ang mga ito.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:915:    <string name="permdesc_accessDrmCertificates">Nagbibigay-daan sa isang application na makapagbigay at gumamit ng mga DRM certficate. Hindi dapat kailanman kailanganin para sa mga normal na app.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:916:    <string name="permdesc_accessFineLocation">Makukuha ng app na ito ang iyong lokasyon batay sa GPS o mga pinagmulan ng lokasyon ng network gaya ng mga cell tower at Wi-Fi network. Ang mga serbisyo ng lokasyon na ito ay dapat naka-on at available sa iyong telepono para sa app upang magamit ang mga ito. Maaaring tumaas ang pagkonsumo sa baterya dahil dito.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:917:    <string name="permdesc_accessImsCallService">Pinapahintulutan ang app na gamitin ang serbisyo ng IMS upang tumawag nang walang pahintulot mo.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:918:    <string name="permdesc_accessLocationExtraCommands">Nagbibigay-daan sa app na mag-access ng mga karagdagang command ng provider ng lokasyon. Maaari nitong bigyang-daan ang app na gambalain ang pagpapatakbo ng GPS o ng iba pang mga pinagmulan ng lokasyon.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:919:    <string name="permdesc_accessNetworkConditions">Nagbibigay-daan sa isang application na makinig sa mga obserbasyon sa mga kondisyon ng network. Dapat na hindi kailanman kakailanganin para sa normal na apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:920:    <string name="permdesc_accessNetworkState">Pinapayagan ang app na tumingin ng impormasyon tungkol sa mga koneksyon ng network gaya ng kung aling mga network ang umiiral at nakakonekta.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:921:    <string name="permdesc_accessNotifications">Pinapayagan ang app na kumuha, sumuri, at mag-clear ng mga notification, kabilang ang mga na-post ng iba pang apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:922:    <string name="permdesc_accessWifiState">Pinapayagan ang app na tumingin ng impormasyon tungkol sa Wi-Fi networking, gaya ng kung pinapagana ang Wi-Fi at pangalan ng mga nakakonektang Wi-Fi device.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:923:    <string name="permdesc_accessWimaxState">Pinapayagan ang app na tukuyin kung pinapagana ang WiMAX at impormasyon tungkol sa anumang mga WiMAX network na nakakonekta.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:924:    <string name="permdesc_access_notification_policy">Nagbibigay-daan sa app na basahin at isulat ang configuration ng Huwag Istorbohin.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:925:    <string name="permdesc_addVoicemail">Pinapayagan ang app na magdagdag ng mga mensahe sa iyong inbox ng voicemail.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:926:    <string name="permdesc_answerPhoneCalls">Pinapayagan ang app na sumagot ng papasok na tawag sa telepono.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:927:    <string name="permdesc_bindCarrierMessagingService">Binibigyang-daan ang may-ari na sumailalim sa interface sa nangungunang antas ng isang serbisyo ng pagmemensahe ng carrier. Hindi kailanman dapat kailanganin para sa mga normal na app.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:928:    <string name="permdesc_bindCarrierServices">Pinapayagan ang may-ari na mag-bind sa mga serbisyo ng carrier. Hindi dapat kailanganin sa mga normal na app.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:929:    <string name="permdesc_bindConditionProviderService">Nagbibigay-daan sa naghahawak na i-bind ang top-level na interface ng isang serbisyo sa pagbibigay ng kondisyon. Hindi kailanman dapat kailanganin ng mga normal na app.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:930:    <string name="permdesc_bindDreamService">Pinapayagan ang may-ari na sumailalim sa interface ng serbisyo ng dream na nasa nangungunang antas. Hindi kailanman dapat na kailanganin para sa mga normal na app.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:931:    <string name="permdesc_bindNotificationListenerService">Nagbibigay-daan sa may-ari na mapailalim sa interface sa tuktok na antas ng isang serbisyo ng notification listener. Hindi dapat kailanganin para sa karaniwang apps kahit kailan.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:932:    <string name="permdesc_bind_connection_service">Pinapayagan ang app na makipag-ugnayan sa mga serbisyo sa telephony upang tumawag/makatanggap ng mga tawag.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:933:    <string name="permdesc_bind_incall_service">Nagbibigay-daan sa app na kontrolin kung kailan at kung paano makikita ng user ang in-call na screen.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:934:    <string name="permdesc_bluetooth">Pinapayagan ang app na tingnan ang configuration ng Bluetooth sa tablet, at na gumawa at tumanggap ng mga koneksyong may mga nakapares na device.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:935:    <string name="permdesc_bluetoothAdmin">Pinapayagan ang app na i-configure ang lokal na Bluetooth tablet, at tumuklas ng at ipares sa mga malayuang device.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:936:    <string name="permdesc_bodySensors">Pinapayagan ang app na i-access ang data mula sa mga sensor na sumusubaybay sa iyong pisikal na kondisyon, tulad ng iyong heart rate.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:937:    <string name="permdesc_broadcastSticky">Pinapayagan ang app na magpadala ng mga sticky na pag-broadcast, na nananatili pagkatapos ng pag-broadcast. Maaaring pabagalin o gawing hindi matatag ng labis na paggamit ang tablet sa pamamagitan ng pagdulot dito na gumamit ng masyadong maraming memory.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:938:    <string name="permdesc_callPhone">Pinapayagan ang app na tumawag sa mga numero ng telepono nang wala ng iyong panghihimasok. Maaari itong magresulta sa mga hindi inaasahang pagsingil o tawag. Tandaan na hindi nito pinapayagan ang app na tumawag sa mga numerong pang-emergency. Maaaring magpagastos sa iyo ng pera ang nakakahamak na apps sa pamamagitan ng pagtawag nang wala ng iyong kumpirmasyon.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:939:    <string name="permdesc_camera">Makakakuha ng mga larawan at makakapag-record ng mga video ang app na ito gamit ang camera anumang oras.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:940:    <string name="permdesc_changeNetworkState">Pinapayagan ang app na baguhin ang katayuan ng pagkakakonekta ng network.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:941:    <string name="permdesc_changeTetherState">Pinapayagan ang app na baguhin ang katayuan ng naka-tether na pagkakakonekta ng network.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:942:    <string name="permdesc_changeWifiMulticastState">Pinapayagan ang app na tumanggap ng mga packet na ipinapadala sa lahat ng device sa isang Wi-Fi network gamit ang mga multicast na address, hindi lang sa iyong tablet. Gumagamit ito ng higit na power kaysa sa mode na hindi multicast.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:943:    <string name="permdesc_changeWifiState">Pinapayagan ang app na kumonekta sa at magdiskonekta mula sa mga Wi-Fi access point at na gumawa ng mga pagbabago sa configuration ng device para sa mga Wi-Fi network.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:944:    <string name="permdesc_changeWimaxState">Pinapayagan ang app na ikonekta ang tablet at idiskonekta ang tablet mula sa mga WiMAX network.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:945:    <string name="permdesc_connection_manager">Pinapayagan ang app na mamahala ng mga koneksyon sa telecom.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:946:    <string name="permdesc_control_incall_experience">Nagbibigay-daan sa app na magbigay ng in-call na karanasan sa user.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:947:    <string name="permdesc_createNetworkSockets">Pinapayagan ang app na lumikha ng mga network socket at gumamit ng mga custom na network protocol. Nagbibigay ang browser at iba pang mga application ng mga paraan ng pagpapadala ng data sa internet, kaya hindi kinakailangan ang pahintulot na ito upang magpadala ng data sa internet.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:948:    <string name="permdesc_disableKeyguard">Pinapayagan ang app na i-disable ang keylock at anumang nauugnay na seguridad sa password. Halimbawa, hindi pinapagana ng telepono ang keylock kapag nakakatanggap ng papasok na tawag sa telepono, pagkatapos ay muling pinapagana ang keylock kapag tapos na ang tawag.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:949:    <string name="permdesc_enableCarMode">Pinapayagan ang app na paganahin ang car mode.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:950:    <string name="permdesc_expandStatusBar">Pinapayagan ang app na palawakin o tiklupin ang status bar.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:951:    <string name="permdesc_foregroundService">Payagan ang app na gamitin ang mga foreground na serbisyo.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:952:    <string name="permdesc_getAccounts">Pinapayagan ang app na kunin ang listahan ng mga account na alam ng tablet. Maaari itong kabilangan ng anumang mga account na nililikha ng mga application na iyong na-install.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:953:    <string name="permdesc_getPackageSize">Pinapayagan ang app na bawiin ang code, data, at mga laki ng cache nito</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:954:    <string name="permdesc_getTasks">Pinapayagan ang app na kumuha ng impormasyon tungkol sa mga kasalukuyan at kamakailang gumaganang gawain. Maaari nitong payagan ang app na tumuklas ng impormasyon tungkol sa kung aling mga application ang ginagamit sa device.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:955:    <string name="permdesc_handoverStatus">Pinapayagan ang application na ito na tumanggap ng impormasyon tungkol sa mga kasalukuyang paglilipat ng Android Beam</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:956:    <string name="permdesc_install_shortcut">Pinapayagan ang isang application na magdagdag ng mga shortcut ng Homescreen nang walang panghihimasok ng user.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:957:    <string name="permdesc_invokeCarrierSetup">Nagbibigay-daan sa may-ari na paganahin ang app ng configuration na ibinigay ng carrier. Hindi dapat kailanganin para sa normal na apps kahit kailan.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:958:    <string name="permdesc_killBackgroundProcesses">Pinapayagan ang app na tapusin ang mga proseso sa background ng iba pang apps. Maaari itong maging sanhi ng paghinto sa paggana ng iba pang apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:959:    <string name="permdesc_manageFingerprint">Pinapayagan ang app na mag-invoke ng mga paraan upang magdagdag at mag-delete ng mga template ng fingerprint na magagamit.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:960:    <string name="permdesc_manageNetworkPolicy">Pinapayagan ang app na pamahalaan ang mga patakaran ng network at ilarawan ang mga patakarang tukoy sa app.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:961:    <string name="permdesc_manageOwnCalls">Pinapayagan ang app na iruta ang mga tawag nito sa pamamagitan ng system upang mapahusay ang karanasan sa pagtawag.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:962:    <string name="permdesc_manageProfileAndDeviceOwners">Nagbibigay-daan sa mga app na itakda ang mga may-ari ng profile at ang may-ari ng device.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:963:    <string name="permdesc_modifyAudioSettings">Pinapayagan ang app na baguhin ang mga pandaigdigang setting ng audio gaya ng volume at kung aling speaker ang ginagamit para sa output.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:964:    <string name="permdesc_modifyNetworkAccounting">Pinapayagan ang app na baguhin kung paano isinasaalang-alang ang paggamit ng network laban sa apps. Hindi para sa paggamit ng normal na apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:965:    <string name="permdesc_nfc">Pinapayagan ang app na makipag-ugnay sa Near Field Communication (NFC) na mga tag, card, at reader.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:966:    <string name="permdesc_persistentActivity">Pinapayagan ang app na panatilihin ang ilang bahagi nito sa memory. Maaari nitong limitahan ang memory na available sa iba pang apps na nagpapabagal sa tablet.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:967:    <string name="permdesc_processOutgoingCalls">Pinapayagan ang app na makita ang numerong idina-dial sa isang papalabas na tawag na may opsyon na i-redirect ang tawag sa ibang numero o itigil ang tawag nang tuluyan.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:968:    <string name="permdesc_readCalendar">Mababasa ng app na ito ang lahat ng event sa kalendaryo na naka-store sa iyong tablet at maibabahagi o mase-save nito ang data ng iyong kalendaryo.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:969:    <string name="permdesc_readCallLog">Mababasa ng app na ito ang iyong history ng tawag.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:970:    <string name="permdesc_readCellBroadcasts">Binibigyang-daan ang app na magbasa ng mga mensahe ng cell broadcast na natanggap ng iyong device. Inihahatid ang mga alerto ng cell broadcast sa ilang lokasyon upang balaan ka tungkol sa mga emergency na sitwasyon. Maaaring makaabala ang nakakahamak na apps sa performance o pagpapatakbo ng iyong device kapag nakatanggap ng emergency na cell broadcast.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:971:    <string name="permdesc_readContacts">Pinapayagan ang app na magbasa ng data tungkol sa mga contact na naka-imbak sa iyong tablet, kabilang ang dalas kung kailan ka tumawag, nag-email, o nakipag-ugnayan sa iba pang mga paraan sa mga tukoy na indibidwal. Pinapayagan ng pahintulot na ito ang apps na i-save ang data ng iyong contact, at maaaring magbahagi ang nakakahamak na apps ng data ng contact nang hindi mo nalalaman.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:972:    <string name="permdesc_readHistoryBookmarks">Pinapayagan ang app na basahin ang kasaysayan ng lahat ng URL na binisita ng Browser, at lahat ng bookmark ng Browser. Tandaan: hindi maaaring ipatupad ang pahintulot na ito ng mga third-party na browser o iba pang mga application na may mga kakayahan sa pagba-browse sa web.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:973:    <string name="permdesc_readInstallSessions">Pinapayagan ang isang application na magbasa ng mga session ng pag-install. Nagbibigay-daan ito upang makita ang mga detalye tungkol sa mga aktibong pag-install ng package.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:974:    <string name="permdesc_readNetworkUsageHistory">Pinapayagan ang app na basahin ang makasaysayang paggamit network para sa mga tukoy na network at apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:975:    <string name="permdesc_readPhoneNumbers">Pinapayagan ang app na i-access ang mga numero ng telepono ng device.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:976:    <string name="permdesc_readPhoneState">"Pinapayagan ang app na i-access ang mga tampok ng telepono ng device. Pinapayagan ng pahintulot na ito ang app na tukuyin ang numero ng telepono at  mga ID ng device, kung aktibo man ang isang tawag, at ang malayuang numerong ikinonekta ng isang tawag."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:977:    <string name="permdesc_readSms">Mababasa ng app na ito ang lahat ng mensaheng SMS (text) na naka-store sa iyong tablet.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:978:    <string name="permdesc_readSyncSettings">Pinapayagan ang app na basahin ang mga setting ng pag-sync para sa isang account. Halimbawa, matutukoy nito kung naka-sync ang app na Mga Tao sa isang account.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:979:    <string name="permdesc_readSyncStats">Pinapayagan ang app na basahin ang mga istatistika ng pag-sync para sa isang account, kabilang ang kasaysayan ng mga event sa pag-sync at kung ilang data ang naka-sync.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:980:    <string name="permdesc_receiveBootCompleted">Pinapayagan ang app na mapasimula ang sarili nito sa sandaling matapos ang system sa pag-boot. Maaari nitong gawing mas matagal upang simulan ang tablet at pinapayagan ang app na pabagalin ang buong tablet sa pamamagitan ng palaging pagtakbo.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:981:    <string name="permdesc_receiveMms">Pinapayagan ang app na tumanggap at magproseso ng mga mensaheng MMS. Nangangahulugan ito na maaaring sumubaybay o magtanggal ang app ng mga mensaheng ipinapadala sa iyong device nang hindi ipinapakita ang mga ito sa iyo.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:982:    <string name="permdesc_receiveSms">Pinapayagan ang app na tumanggap at magproseso ng mga mensaheng SMS. Nangangahulugan ito na maaaring sumubaybay o magtanggal ang app ng mga mensaheng ipinapadala sa iyong device nang hindi ipinapakita ang mga ito sa iyo.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:983:    <string name="permdesc_receiveWapPush">Pinapayagan ang app na tumanggap at magproseso ng mga mensaheng WAP. Kabilang sa pahintulot na ito ang kakayahang sumubaybay o magtanggal ang app ng mga mensaheng ipinapadala sa iyo nang hindi ipinapakita ang mga ito sa iyo.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:984:    <string name="permdesc_recordAudio">Makakapag-record ng audio ang app na ito gamit ang mikropono anumang oras.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:985:    <string name="permdesc_register_call_provider">Pinapayagan ang app na magrehistro ng mga bagong koneksyon sa telecom.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:986:    <string name="permdesc_register_sim_subscription">Pinapayagan ang app na magrehistro ng mga bagong koneksyon sa SIM ng telecom.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:987:    <string name="permdesc_removeDrmCertificates">Nagbibigay-daan sa isang application na alisin ang mga DRM certficate. Hindi dapat kailanman kailanganin para sa karaniwang apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:988:    <string name="permdesc_reorderTasks">Pinapayagan ang app na maglipat ng mga gawain sa foreground at background. Maaari itong gawin ng app nang wala ng iyong input.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:989:    <string name="permdesc_requestDeletePackages">Pinapayagan ang isang application na humiling ng pag-delete ng mga package.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:990:    <string name="permdesc_requestIgnoreBatteryOptimizations">Pinapayagang humingi ng pahintulot ang isang app na balewalain ang mga pag-optimize ng baterya para sa app na iyon.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:991:    <string name="permdesc_requestInstallPackages">Pinapayagan ang isang application na hilingin ang pag-install ng mga package.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:992:    <string name="permdesc_route_media_output">Pinapayagan ang application na mag-route ng output ng media sa iba pang mga panlabas na device.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:993:    <string name="permdesc_runInBackground">Maaaring tumakbo sa background ang app na ito. Maaaring mas mabilis nitong maubos ang baterya.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:994:    <string name="permdesc_sdcardRead">Pinapayagan ang app na basahin ang mga nilalaman ng iyong SD card.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:995:    <string name="permdesc_sdcardWrite">Pinapayagan ang app na magsulat sa SD card.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:996:    <string name="permdesc_sendSms">Pinapayagan ang app na magpadala ng mga mensaheng SMS. Maaari itong magresulta sa mga hindi inaasahang pagsingil. Maaaring magpagastos sa iyo ng pera ang nakakahamak na apps sa pamamagitan ng pagpapadala ng mga mensahe nang wala ng iyong kumpirmasyon.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:997:    <string name="permdesc_setAlarm">Pinapayagan ang app na magtakda ng alarm sa isang naka-install na app ng alarm clock. Maaaring hindi ipatupad ng ilang apps ng alarm clock ang tampok na ito.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:998:    <string name="permdesc_setInputCalibration">Pinapayagan ang app na baguhin ang mga parameter sa pag-calibrate ng touch screen. Hindi dapat kailanganin sa normal na apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:999:    <string name="permdesc_setTimeZone">Pinapayagan ang app na baguhin ang time zone ng tablet.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1000:    <string name="permdesc_setWallpaper">Pinapayagan ang app na itakda ang wallpaper ng system.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1001:    <string name="permdesc_setWallpaperHints">Pinapayagan ang app na itakda ang mga pahiwatig sa laki ng wallpaper ng system.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1002:    <string name="permdesc_sim_communication">Pinapahintulutang magpadala ang app ng mga command sa SIM. Napakapanganib nito.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1003:    <string name="permdesc_statusBar">Pinapayagan ang app na i-disable ang status bar o magdagdag at mag-alis ng mga icon ng system.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1004:    <string name="permdesc_statusBarService">Pinapayagan ang app na maging status bar.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1005:    <string name="permdesc_subscribedFeedsRead">Pinapayagan ang app na kumuha ng mga detalye tungkol sa kasalukuyang naka-sync na mga feed.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1006:    <string name="permdesc_systemAlertWindow">Maaaring lumabas ang app na ito sa ibabaw ng iba pang mga app o iba pang mga bahagi ng screen. Maaaring makasagabal ito sa normal na paggamit ng app at mabago nito ang paraan kung paano lumalabas ang iba pang mga app.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1007:    <string name="permdesc_transmitIr">Nagbibigay-daan sa app na gamitin ang infrared transmitter ng tablet.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1008:    <string name="permdesc_uninstall_shortcut">Pinapayagan ang application na alisin ang mga shortcut ng Homescreen nang walang panghihimasok ng user.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1009:    <string name="permdesc_useBiometric">Pinapayagan ang app na gumamit ng biometric hardware para sa pag-authenticate</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1010:    <string name="permdesc_useDataInBackground">Maaaring gumamit ng data sa background ang app na ito. Maaaring mas maraming data ang magamit nito.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1011:    <string name="permdesc_useFingerprint">Pinapayagan ang app na gumamit ng hardware ng fingerprint para sa pagpapatotoo</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1012:    <string name="permdesc_use_sip">Pinapayagan ang app na magsagawa at makatanggap ng mga tawag sa SIP.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1013:    <string name="permdesc_vibrate">Pinapayagan ang app na kontrolin ang vibrator.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1014:    <string name="permdesc_wakeLock">Pinapayagan ang app na pigilan ang tablet mula sa pag-sleep.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1015:    <string name="permdesc_writeCalendar">Makakapagdagdag, makakapag-alis o makakapagbago ang app na ito ng mga event sa kalendaryo sa iyong tablet. Magagawa ng app na ito na magpadala ng mga mensahe na maaaring mukhang mula sa mga may-ari ng kalendaryo o magbago ng mga event nang hindi inaabisuhan ang mga may-ari nito.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1016:    <string name="permdesc_writeCallLog">Binibigyan-daan ang app na baguhin ang log ng tawag ng iyong tablet, kabilang ang data tungkol sa mga paparating at papalabas na tawag. Maaari itong gamitin ng nakakahamak na apps upang burahin o baguhin ang iyong log ng tawag.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1017:    <string name="permdesc_writeContacts">Pinapayagan ang app na baguhin ang data tungkol sa iyong mga contact na naka-imbak sa iyong tablet, kabilang ang dalas kung kailan ka tumawag, nag-email, o nakipag-ugnayan sa iba pang mga paraan sa mga tukoy na contact. Pinapayagan ng pahintulot na ito ang apps na magtanggal ng data ng contact.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1018:    <string name="permdesc_writeGeolocationPermissions">Pinapayagan ang app na baguhin ang mga pahintulot sa geolocation ng Browser. Maaari itong gamitin ng nakakahamak na apps upang payagan ang pagpapadala ng impormasyon ng lokasyon sa mga hindi tukoy na web site.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1019:    <string name="permdesc_writeHistoryBookmarks">Pinapayagan ang app na baguhin ang kasaysayan o mga bookmark ng Browser na naka-imbak sa iyong tablet. Maaari nitong payagan ang app na burahin o baguhin ang data ng Browser. Tandaan: hindi maaaring ipatupad ang pahintulot na ito ng mga third-party na browser o iba pang mga application na may mga kakayahan sa pagba-browse sa web.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1020:    <string name="permdesc_writeSettings">Pinapayagan ang app na baguhin ang data ng mga setting ng system. Maaaring sirain ng nakakahamak na apps ang configuration ng iyong system.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tl/strings.xml:1021:    <string name="permdesc_writeSyncSettings">Pinapayagan ang isang app na baguhin ang mga setting ng pag-sync para sa isang account. Halimbawa, magagamit ito upang paganahin ang pag-sync ng app na Mga Tao sa isang account.</string>

analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:913:    <string name="permdesc_acceptHandovers">Uygulamanın, başka bir uygulamada başlatılan çağrıya devam etmesine izin verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:914:    <string name="permdesc_accessCoarseLocation">Bu uygulama baz istasyonu ve kablosuz ağ gibi ağ kaynaklarını kullanarak konumunuzu belirleyebilir. Uygulamanın bu hizmetleri kullanabilmesi için tabletinizde bu konum hizmetleri açık ve kullanılabilir olmalıdır.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:915:    <string name="permdesc_accessDrmCertificates">Bir uygulamanın DRM sertifikaları için temel hazırlık yapmasına ve bunları kullanmasına izin verir. Normal uygulamalar için hiçbir zaman gerekmez.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:916:    <string name="permdesc_accessFineLocation">Bu uygulama baz istasyonu ve kablosuz ağ gibi ağ kaynaklarını kullanarak konumunuzu belirleyebilir. Uygulamanın bu hizmetleri kullanabilmesi için telefonunuzda bu konum hizmetleri açık ve kullanılabilir olmalıdır. Bu hizmet pil tüketimini artırabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:917:    <string name="permdesc_accessImsCallService">Uygulamanın, sizin müdahaleniz olmadan telefon etmek için IMS hizmetini kullanmasına izin verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:918:    <string name="permdesc_accessLocationExtraCommands">Uygulamanın, ekstra konum sağlayıcı komutlarına erişmesine izin verir. Bu izin, uygulamanın GPS veya diğer konum kaynaklarının çalışmasını kesmesine olanak sağlayabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:919:    <string name="permdesc_accessNetworkConditions">Bir uygulamaya, ağ koşullarındaki gözlemleri dinleme izni verir. Normal uygulamalar için hiçbir zaman gerekmez.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:920:    <string name="permdesc_accessNetworkState">Uygulamaya, hangi ağların bulunduğu ve hangilerinin bağlı olduğu gibi ağ bağlantılarıyla ilgili bilgileri görüntüleme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:921:    <string name="permdesc_accessNotifications">Uygulamanın bildirimler almasına, bildirimleri incelemesine ve temizlemesine izin verir. Buna diğer uygulamalar tarafından yayınlanan bildirimler de dahildir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:922:    <string name="permdesc_accessWifiState">Uygulamaya, Kablosuz bağlantının etkin olup olmadığı ve bağlanan Kablosuz cihazların adları gibi Kablosuz ağ kullanımıyla ilgili bilgileri görüntüleme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:923:    <string name="permdesc_accessWimaxState">"Uygulamaya, WiMAX'in etkin olup olmadığını belirleme ve bağlı tüm WiMAX ağlarıyla ilgili bilgilere erişme izni verir."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:924:    <string name="permdesc_access_notification_policy">Uygulamaya, Rahatsız Etmeyin yapılandırmasını okuma ve yazma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:925:    <string name="permdesc_addVoicemail">Uygulamaya, sesli mesaj gelen kutunuza mesaj ekleme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:926:    <string name="permdesc_answerPhoneCalls">Uygulamanın gelen bir telefon çağrısına yanıt vermesine olanak tanır.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:927:    <string name="permdesc_bindCarrierMessagingService">İzin sahibinin, operatör mesajlaşma hizmetinin üst düzey arayüzüne bağlanmasına olanak verir. Normal uygulamalarda hiçbir zaman gerekmez.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:928:    <string name="permdesc_bindCarrierServices">İzin sahibinin, operatör hizmetlerine bağlanmasına olanak tanır. Normal uygulamalarda hiçbir zaman gerekmez.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:929:    <string name="permdesc_bindConditionProviderService">İzin sahibinin, bir durum sağlayıcı hizmete ait üst düzey arayüze bağlanmasına izin verir. Normal uygulamalar için hiçbir zaman gerekli değildir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:930:    <string name="permdesc_bindDreamService">İzin sahibine bir dream hizmetinin üst seviye arayüzüne bağlanma olanağı sunar. Normal uygulamalarda hiçbir zaman ihtiyaç duyulmamalıdır.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:931:    <string name="permdesc_bindNotificationListenerService">İzin sahibine bir bildirim dinleyici hizmetinin en üst düzey arayüzüne bağlanma izni verir. Normal uygulamalarda hiçbir zaman gerek duyulmaz.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:932:    <string name="permdesc_bind_connection_service">Uygulamanın çağrı yapmak/almak için telefon hizmetleriyle etkileşimde bulunmasına izin verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:933:    <string name="permdesc_bind_incall_service">Uygulamaya, kullanıcının çağrı ekranını ne zaman ve nasıl göreceğini denetleme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:934:    <string name="permdesc_bluetooth">Uygulamaya, tabletteki Bluetooth yapılandırmasını görüntüleme, eşlenmiş cihazlarla bağlantı yapma ve bu tür bağlantıları kabul etme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:935:    <string name="permdesc_bluetoothAdmin">Uygulamaya, yerel Bluetooth tabletini yapılandırma ve uzak cihazları keşfedip bunlarla eşleşme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:936:    <string name="permdesc_bodySensors">Uygulamanın, nabzınız gibi fiziksel durumunuzu izleyen sensörlerin gönderdiği verilere erişmesine izin verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:937:    <string name="permdesc_broadcastSticky">Uygulamaya, yayın bittikten sonra da kalan sabit yayınlar gönderme izni verir. Aşırı kullanılması çok fazla bellek harcanmasına neden olarak tableti yavaşlatabilir veya dengesiz hale getirebilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:938:    <string name="permdesc_callPhone">Uygulamaya sizin müdahaleniz olmadan telefon numaralarına çağrı yapma izni verir. Bu durum beklenmeyen ödemelere veya çağrılara neden olabilir. Ancak bu iznin, uygulamanın acil numaralara çağrı yapmasına olanak sağlamadığını unutmayın. Kötü amaçlı uygulamalar onayınız olmadan çağrılar yaparak sizi zarara sokabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:939:    <string name="permdesc_camera">Bu uygulama, herhangi bir zamanda kamerayı kullanarak fotoğraf ve video çekebilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:940:    <string name="permdesc_changeNetworkState">Uygulamaya, ağ bağlantısının durumunu değiştirme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:941:    <string name="permdesc_changeTetherState">Uygulamaya, tethering kullanan ağ bağlantısının durumunu değiştirme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:942:    <string name="permdesc_changeWifiMulticastState">Uygulamaya, çoklu yayın adreslerini kullanarak yalnızca tablete değil Kablosuz ağ üzerindeki tüm cihazlara gönderilen paketleri alma izni verir. Çoklu olmayan yayın moduna göre daha fazla güç tüketir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:943:    <string name="permdesc_changeWifiState">Uygulamaya, kablosuz erişim noktalarına bağlanıp bunlarla bağlantısını kesme ve Kablosuz ağlar için cihaz yapılandırmasında değişiklikler yapma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:944:    <string name="permdesc_changeWimaxState">Uygulamaya, tableti WiMAX ağlarına bağlanma veya bağlantıyı kesme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:945:    <string name="permdesc_connection_manager">Uygulamanın telekomünikasyon bağlantılarını yönetmesine izin verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:946:    <string name="permdesc_control_incall_experience">Uygulamaya, çağrı içi kullanım deneyimi sağlama izin verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:947:    <string name="permdesc_createNetworkSockets">"Uygulamaya ağ yuvaları oluşturma ve özel ağ protokolleri kullanma izni verir. Tarayıcı ve diğer uygulamalar İnternet'e veri gönderilmesi için araç sağlarlar, bu nedenle bu izin, İnternet'e veri göndermek için gerekli değildir."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:948:    <string name="permdesc_disableKeyguard">Uygulamaya, tuş kilidini ve ilişkili tüm şifreli güvenlik önlemlerini devre dışı bırakma izni verir. Örneğin, telefon, çağrı alındığında tuş kilidinin devre dışı bırakır ve sonra, görüşme bittiğinde kilidi yeniden etkinleştirir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:949:    <string name="permdesc_enableCarMode">Uygulamaya, araç modunu etkinleştirme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:950:    <string name="permdesc_expandStatusBar">Uygulamaya, durum çubuğunu genişletip daraltma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:951:    <string name="permdesc_foregroundService">Uygulamanın ön plan hizmetlerinden faydalanmasına izin verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:952:    <string name="permdesc_getAccounts">Uygulamaya tablet tarafından bilinen hesapların listesini alma izni verir. Bu liste, yüklediğiniz uygulamalar tarafından oluşturulan tüm hesapları içerebilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:953:    <string name="permdesc_getPackageSize">Uygulamaya kodunu, verilerini ve önbellek boyutlarını alma izni verir</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:954:    <string name="permdesc_getTasks">Uygulamaya o anda ve son çalışan görevler hakkında bilgi alma izni verir. Bu izin, uygulamanın cihaz tarafından kullanılan uygulamalar hakkında bilgi elde etmesine olanak sağlayabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:955:    <string name="permdesc_handoverStatus">Bu uygulamanın mevcut Android Beam aktarımlarıyla ilgili bilgi almasına izin verir</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:956:    <string name="permdesc_install_shortcut">Uygulamaya, kullanıcı müdahalesi olmadan kısayolları Ana Ekrana ekleme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:957:    <string name="permdesc_invokeCarrierSetup">İzin sahibine, operatör tarafından sağlanan yapılandırma uygulamasını çalıştırma izni verir. Normal uygulamalarda hiçbir zaman gerek duyulmaz.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:958:    <string name="permdesc_killBackgroundProcesses">Uygulamaya diğer uygulamalara ait arka plan işlemleri sonlandırma izni verir. Bu izin, diğer uygulamaların çalışmayı durdurmasına neden olabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:959:    <string name="permdesc_manageFingerprint">Uygulamanın, kullanılacak parmak izi şablonlarını ekleme ve silme yöntemlerini başlatmasına izin verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:960:    <string name="permdesc_manageNetworkPolicy">Uygulamaya, ağ politikalarını yönetme ve uygulamaya özgü kuralları tanımlama izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:961:    <string name="permdesc_manageOwnCalls">Uygulamanın, çağrı deneyimini iyileştirmek için çağrılarını sistem üzerinden yönlendirmesine olanak tanır.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:962:    <string name="permdesc_manageProfileAndDeviceOwners">Uygulamaların, profil sahiplerini ve cihaz sahibini ayarlamasına izin verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:963:    <string name="permdesc_modifyAudioSettings">Uygulamaya ses düzeyi ve ses çıkışı için kullanılan hoparlör gibi genel ses ayarlarını değiştirme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:964:    <string name="permdesc_modifyNetworkAccounting">Uygulamaya, ağın uygulamalara göre nasıl kullanılacağını değiştirme izni verir. Normal uygulamalar tarafından kullanılmak için değildir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:965:    <string name="permdesc_nfc">Uygulamaya, Near Field Communication (NFC) etiketleri, kartlar ve okuyucular ile iletişim kurma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:966:    <string name="permdesc_persistentActivity">Uygulamaya kendisinin bir bölümünü bellekte kalıcı yapma izni verir. Bu izin, diğer uygulamaların kullanabileceği belleği sınırlandırarak tabletin yavaş çalışmasına neden olabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:967:    <string name="permdesc_processOutgoingCalls">Uygulamaya, giden bir çağrının numarası çevrilirken çağrıyı farklı bir numaraya yönlendirme ya da tamamen kapatma seçeneğiyle birlikte numarayı görme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:968:    <string name="permdesc_readCalendar">Bu uygulama, tabletinizde kayıtlı tüm takvim etkinliklerini okuyabilir ve takvim verilerinizi paylaşabilir ya da kaydedebilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:969:    <string name="permdesc_readCallLog">Bu uygulama, çağrı geçmişinizi okuyabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:970:    <string name="permdesc_readCellBroadcasts">Uygulamaya, cihazınız tarafından alınan hücre yayını mesajlarını okuma izni verir. Hücre yayını uyarıları bazı yerlerde acil durumlar konusunda sizi uyarmak için gönderilir. Kötü amaçlı uygulamalar acil hücre yayını alındığında cihazınızın performansına ya da çalışmasına engel olabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:971:    <string name="permdesc_readContacts">Uygulamaya tabletinizde depolanan kişilerinizle ilgili verileri okuma izni verir. Bu verilere belirli kişilerle ne sıklıkta çağrı, e-posta veya diğer yöntemlerle iletişim kurduğunuz bilgisi dahildir. Bu izin, uygulamanın kişi verilerinizi kaydetmesine olanak sağlar ve kötü amaçlı uygulamalar kişi verilerini haberiniz olmadan paylaşabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:972:    <string name="permdesc_readHistoryBookmarks">"Uygulamaya Tarayıcının ziyaret ettiği tüm URL'lerin geçmişini ve tüm Tarayıcı yer işaretlerini okuma izni verir. Not: Bu izin, üçüncü taraf tarayıcılar veya Web'e göz atma işlevine sahip diğer uygulamalar tarafından kullanılmayabilir."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:973:    <string name="permdesc_readInstallSessions">Bir uygulamanın yükleme oturumlarını okumasına izin verir. Bu, etkin paket yüklemeleriyle ilgili ayrıntıların görülmesine olanak tanır.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:974:    <string name="permdesc_readNetworkUsageHistory">Uygulamaya, özel ağlar ve uygulamalar için ağ kullanım geçmişini okuma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:975:    <string name="permdesc_readPhoneNumbers">Uygulamaya, cihazınızın telefon numaralarına erişme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:976:    <string name="permdesc_readPhoneState">Uygulamaya cihazdaki telefon özelliklerine erişme izni verir. Bu izin, uygulamanın telefon numarasını ve cihaz kimliğini, etkin bir çağrı olup olmadığını ve çağrıda bağlanılan karşı tarafın numarasını öğrenmesine olanak sağlar.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:977:    <string name="permdesc_readSms">Bu uygulama, tabletinizde kayıtlı tüm SMS mesajlarını (kısa mesajları) okuyabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:978:    <string name="permdesc_readSyncSettings">Uygulamaya bir hesaba ait senkronizasyon ayarlarını okuma izni verir. Örneğin, bu izne sahip bir uygulama Kişiler uygulamasının bir hesapla senkronize olup olmadığını belirleyebilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:979:    <string name="permdesc_readSyncStats">Uygulamaya bir hesaba ait senkronizasyon istatistiklerini okuma izni verir. Buna senkronizasyon etkinlikleri geçmişi ve senkronize edilen veri miktarı bilgileri de dahildir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:980:    <string name="permdesc_receiveBootCompleted">Uygulamaya, kendisini sistem açılışı bittikten hemen sonra başlatma izni verir. Bu izin, tabletin başlaması için daha uzun süre geçmesine ve uygulamanın her zaman çalışarak tableti yavaşlatmasına neden olabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:981:    <string name="permdesc_receiveMms">Uygulamaya MMS iletilerini alma ve işleme izni verir. Bu izin, uygulamanın cihazınıza gönderilen iletileri takip edip size göstermeden silebileceği anlamına gelir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:982:    <string name="permdesc_receiveSms">Uygulamaya SMS iletilerini alma ve işleme izni verir. Bu izin, uygulamanın cihazınıza gönderilen iletileri takip edip size göstermeden silebileceği anlamına gelir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:983:    <string name="permdesc_receiveWapPush">Uygulamaya WAP mesajlarını alma ve işleme izni verir. Buna, size gönderilen mesajları takip edip size göstermeden silebilme izni de dahildir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:984:    <string name="permdesc_recordAudio">Bu uygulama, istediği zaman mikrofonu kullanarak ses kaydedebilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:985:    <string name="permdesc_register_call_provider">Uygulamanın yeni telekomünikasyon bağlantıları kaydettirmesine izin verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:986:    <string name="permdesc_register_sim_subscription">Uygulamanın yeni telekomünikasyon SIM bağlantıları kaydettirmesine izin verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:987:    <string name="permdesc_removeDrmCertificates">Uygulamaya, DRM sertifikalarını kaldırma izin verir. Normal uygulamalar için asla gerekmemelidir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:988:    <string name="permdesc_reorderTasks">Uygulamaya, görevleri ön plana ve arka plana taşıma izni verir. Uygulama bunu sizden bir giriş olmadan yapabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:989:    <string name="permdesc_requestDeletePackages">Uygulamaya, paketleri silme isteğinde bulunma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:990:    <string name="permdesc_requestIgnoreBatteryOptimizations">Bir uygulamanın, kendisi için pil optimizasyonlarını göz ardı etme izni istemesine olanak sağlar.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:991:    <string name="permdesc_requestInstallPackages">Uygulamaya, paketleri yükleme isteğinde bulunma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:992:    <string name="permdesc_route_media_output">Uygulamaya medya çıktısını başka harici cihazlara yönlendirme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:993:    <string name="permdesc_runInBackground">Bu uygulama arka planda çalıştırılabilir. Bu durum pilinizin daha hızlı boşalmasına neden olabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:994:    <string name="permdesc_sdcardRead">Uygulamaya, SD kartınızın içeriğini okuma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:995:    <string name="permdesc_sdcardWrite">Uygulamaya, SD karta yazma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:996:    <string name="permdesc_sendSms">Uygulamaya SMS iletisi gönderme izni verir. Bu durum beklenmeyen ödemelere neden olabilir. Kötü amaçlı uygulamalar onayınız olmadan iletiler göndererek sizi zarara uğratabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:997:    <string name="permdesc_setAlarm">Uygulamaya, çalar saat uygulamasının alarmını ayarlama izni verir. Bazı çalar saat uygulamaları bu özelliği uygulayamayabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:998:    <string name="permdesc_setInputCalibration">Uygulamaya, dokunmatik ekranın kalibrasyon parametrelerini değiştirme izni verir. Normal uygulamalar için hiçbir zaman gerekmez.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:999:    <string name="permdesc_setTimeZone">Uygulamaya, tabletin saat dilimini değiştirme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1000:    <string name="permdesc_setWallpaper">Uygulamaya, sistem duvar kağıdını ayarlama izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1001:    <string name="permdesc_setWallpaperHints">Uygulamaya, sistem duvar kağıdı için boyut ipuçlarını ayarlama izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1002:    <string name="permdesc_sim_communication">Uygulamanın SIM karta komut göndermesine izin verir. Bu izin çok tehlikelidir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1003:    <string name="permdesc_statusBar">Uygulamaya, durum çubuğunu devre dışı bırakma ve sistem simgelerini ekleyip kaldırma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1004:    <string name="permdesc_statusBarService">Uygulamaya, durum çubuğu olma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1005:    <string name="permdesc_subscribedFeedsRead">Uygulamaya, o anda senkronize olan özet akışları ile ilgili bilgi alma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1006:    <string name="permdesc_systemAlertWindow">Bu uygulama, uygulamaların üzerinde veya ekranın diğer kısımlarında görünebilir. Bu durum, normal uygulama kullanımını etkileyebilir ve diğer uygulamaların görünümünü değiştirebilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1007:    <string name="permdesc_transmitIr">Uygulamaya, tabletin kızıl ötesi vericisini kullanma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1008:    <string name="permdesc_uninstall_shortcut">Uygulamaya, kullanıcının müdahalesi olmadan kısayolları Ana Ekrandan kaldırma izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1009:    <string name="permdesc_useBiometric">Uygulamanın kimlik doğrulama için biyometrik donanım kullanmasına izin verir</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1010:    <string name="permdesc_useDataInBackground">Bu uygulama, arka planda verileri kullanabilir. Bu durum veri kullanımını artırabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1011:    <string name="permdesc_useFingerprint">Uygulamanın kimlik doğrulama için parmak izi donanımını kullanmasına izin verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1012:    <string name="permdesc_use_sip">Uygulamanın SIP çağrıları yapmasına ve almasına izin verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1013:    <string name="permdesc_vibrate">Uygulamaya, titreşimi denetleme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1014:    <string name="permdesc_wakeLock">Uygulamaya, tabletin uykuya geçmesini önleme izni verir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1015:    <string name="permdesc_writeCalendar">Bu uygulama, tabletinize takvim etkinlikleri ekleyebilir, mevcut etkinlikleri kaldırabilir ve değiştirebilir. Bu uygulama, takvim sahiplerinden gelmiş gibi görünen iletiler gönderebilir veya takvim sahiplerinin bilgisi olmadan etkinlikleri değiştirebilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1016:    <string name="permdesc_writeCallLog">Uygulamaya tabletinizin çağrı günlüğünde (gelen ve giden çağrılarla ilgili veriler dahil olmak üzere) değişiklik yapma izni verir. Kötü amaçlı uygulamalar bu izni kullanarak çağrı günlüğünüzü silebilir veya değiştirebilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1017:    <string name="permdesc_writeContacts">Uygulamaya tabletinizde depolanan kişilerinizle ilgili verileri değiştirme izni verir. Bu verilere belirli kişilerle ne sıklıkta çağrı, e-posta veya diğer yöntemlerle iletişim kurduğunuz bilgisi dahildir. Bu izin, uygulamanın kişi verilerinizi silmesine olanak sağlar.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1018:    <string name="permdesc_writeGeolocationPermissions">"Uygulamaya, Tarayıcı'nın coğrafi konum izinlerini değiştirme izni verir. Kötü amaçlı uygulamalar keyfi web sitelerine konum bilgisi gönderilmesini sağlamak için bunu kullanabilirler."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1019:    <string name="permdesc_writeHistoryBookmarks">"Uygulamaya Tarayıcı geçmişini ve tabletinizde depolanan yer işaretlerini değiştirme izni verir. Bu izin, uygulamanın Tarayıcı geçmişini silmesine ve değiştirmesine olanak sağlar. Not: Bu izin, üçüncü taraf cihazlar veya Web'e göz atma işlevine sahip diğer uygulamalar tarafından kullanılmayabilir."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1020:    <string name="permdesc_writeSettings">Uygulamaya, sistem ayarı verilerini değiştirme izni verir. Kötü amaçlı uygulamalar sistem yapılandırmanızı bozabilir.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-tr/strings.xml:1021:    <string name="permdesc_writeSyncSettings">Uygulamaya bir hesaba ait senkronizasyon ayarlarını değiştirme izni verir. Örneğin, bu izne sahip bir uygulama Kişiler uygulamasının bir hesapla senkronize edilmesini etkinleştirebilir.</string>

analysis/apktool/res/values-uk/strings.xml:191:    <string name="bugreport_option_full_summary">Підходить для мінімального втручання в систему, коли пристрій не відповідає, працює повільно або вам потрібні всі розділи звіту.
