analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:913:    <string name="permdesc_acceptHandovers">允許應用程式繼續進行在其他應用程式中發起的通話。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:914:    <string name="permdesc_accessCoarseLocation">這個應用程式可根據網路來源 (例如基地台和 Wi-Fi 網路) 取得你的位置資訊。你必須在平板電腦上開啟這類定位服務，才能讓這個應用程式取得位置資訊。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:915:    <string name="permdesc_accessDrmCertificates">允許應用程式佈建及使用 DRM 憑證 (一般應用程式並不需要)。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:916:    <string name="permdesc_accessFineLocation">這個應用程式可根據 GPS 或網路位置來源 (例如基地台和 Wi-Fi 網路) 取得你的位置資訊。你必須在手機上開啟這類定位服務，才能讓這個應用程式取得位置資訊。不過這可能會增加耗電量。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:917:    <string name="permdesc_accessImsCallService">允許應用程式自動使用 IMS 服務撥打電話。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:918:    <string name="permdesc_accessLocationExtraCommands">允許應用程式存取額外位置資訊提供者指令。這項設定可能會造成應用程式干擾 GPS 或其他位置資訊來源的運作。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:919:    <string name="permdesc_accessNetworkConditions">允許應用程式監聽網路狀況觀察資訊 (一般應用程式並不需要)。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:920:    <string name="permdesc_accessNetworkState">允許應用程式查看網路連線相關資訊，例如有哪些網路，以及已連上哪些網路。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:921:    <string name="permdesc_accessNotifications">允許應用程式擷取、檢查及清除通知 (包括由其他應用程式發佈的通知)。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:922:    <string name="permdesc_accessWifiState">允許應用程式查看 Wi-Fi 網路相關資訊，例如是否已啟用 Wi-Fi，以及所連上 Wi-Fi 裝置的名稱。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:923:    <string name="permdesc_accessWimaxState">允許應用程式判斷是否已啟用 WiMAX，以及判讀任何已連上 WiMAX 網路的相關資訊。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:924:    <string name="permdesc_access_notification_policy">允許應用程式讀取及寫入「零打擾」設定。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:925:    <string name="permdesc_addVoicemail">允許應用程式將訊息新增至你的語音信箱收件匣。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:926:    <string name="permdesc_answerPhoneCalls">允許應用程式接聽來電。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:927:    <string name="permdesc_bindCarrierMessagingService">允許應用程式與電信業者簡訊服務的頂層介面繫結 (一般應用程式並不需要)。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:928:    <string name="permdesc_bindCarrierServices">允許應用程式繫結至電信業者服務 (一般應用程式並不需要)。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:929:    <string name="permdesc_bindConditionProviderService">允許應用程式繫結至條件提供者服務的頂層介面 (一般應用程式並不需要)。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:930:    <string name="permdesc_bindDreamService">允許應用程式繫結至 Dream 服務的頂層介面 (一般應用程式不需使用)。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:931:    <string name="permdesc_bindNotificationListenerService">允許應用程式繫結至通知接聽器服務的頂層介面 (一般應用程式不需使用)。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:932:    <string name="permdesc_bind_connection_service">允許應用程式與電話語音服務互動以撥接電話。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:933:    <string name="permdesc_bind_incall_service">允許應用程式控制使用者看到通話螢幕的時機和方式。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:934:    <string name="permdesc_bluetooth">允許應用程式查看平板電腦的藍牙設定，以及建立和接受與其他配對裝置的連線。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:935:    <string name="permdesc_bluetoothAdmin">允許應用程式設定本機藍牙平板電腦，以及搜尋遠端裝置並配對連線。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:936:    <string name="permdesc_bodySensors">允許應用程式存取感測器所收集的資料 (這類感測器可監測你的體能狀態，例如你的心跳速率)。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:937:    <string name="permdesc_broadcastSticky">允許應用程式傳送記憶廣播，這類廣播在廣播動作結束後仍繼續存在。請注意，過度使用此功能可能導致平板電腦使用過多的記憶體，導致平板電腦的執行速度變慢或不穩定。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:938:    <string name="permdesc_callPhone">允許應用程式自行撥打電話，但可能產生非預期的費用或撥打非預期的電話。注意：這項權限不允許應用程式撥打緊急電話。惡意應用程式可能利用此功能擅自撥打電話，增加你不必要的額外支出。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:939:    <string name="permdesc_camera">這個應用程式隨時可使用相機拍照及錄影。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:940:    <string name="permdesc_changeNetworkState">允許應用程式變更網路連線狀態。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:941:    <string name="permdesc_changeTetherState">允許應用程式變更共用網路的連線狀態。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:942:    <string name="permdesc_changeWifiMulticastState">允許應用程式接收透過多點傳播位址傳送給 Wi-Fi 網路上所有裝置 (而不只是傳送給你的平板電腦) 的封包。這項設定會比非多點傳播模式耗用更多電力。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:943:    <string name="permdesc_changeWifiState">允許應用程式與 Wi-Fi 存取點連線或中斷連線，並可變更 Wi-Fi 網路的裝置設定。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:944:    <string name="permdesc_changeWimaxState">允許應用程式建立或中斷平板電腦與 WiMAX 網路的連線。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:945:    <string name="permdesc_connection_manager">允許應用程式管理電信連線。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:946:    <string name="permdesc_control_incall_experience">允許應用程式向使用者提供通話體驗。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:947:    <string name="permdesc_createNetworkSockets">允許應用程式建立網路通訊端及使用自訂網路通訊協定。瀏覽器和其他應用程式會提供將資料傳輸到網際網路的方法，因此不需要這項權限也能將資料傳輸到網際網路。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:948:    <string name="permdesc_disableKeyguard">允許應用程式停用按鍵鎖定以及其他相關的密碼安全性功能。例如：手機收到來電時停用按鍵鎖定，通話結束後重新啟用按鍵鎖定。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:949:    <string name="permdesc_enableCarMode">允許應用程式啟用車用模式。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:950:    <string name="permdesc_expandStatusBar">允許應用程式展開或收合狀態列。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:951:    <string name="permdesc_foregroundService">允許應用程式使用前景服務。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:952:    <string name="permdesc_getAccounts">允許應用程式取得平板電腦上所記憶的帳戶清單，其中可能包括你安裝的應用程式所建立的任何帳戶。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:953:    <string name="permdesc_getPackageSize">允許應用程式擷取本身的程式碼、資料及快取大小</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:954:    <string name="permdesc_getTasks">允許應用程式擷取最近執行工作的資訊。這項設定可讓應用程式找出裝置所用程式的相關資訊。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:955:    <string name="permdesc_handoverStatus">允許應用程式接收 Android Beam 目前傳輸的資訊</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:956:    <string name="permdesc_install_shortcut">允許應用程式自動新增主螢幕捷徑。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:957:    <string name="permdesc_invokeCarrierSetup">允許應用程式叫用電信業者提供的設定應用程式 (一般應用程式並不需要)。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:958:    <string name="permdesc_killBackgroundProcesses">允許應用程式終止其他應用程式的背景處理程序。這項設定可能會導致其他應用程式停止執行。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:959:    <string name="permdesc_manageFingerprint">允許應用程式呼叫方法來新增及移除可用的指紋範本</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:960:    <string name="permdesc_manageNetworkPolicy">允許應用程式管理網路政策並定義應用程式專用規則。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:961:    <string name="permdesc_manageOwnCalls">允許應用程式透過系統接通來電，以改善通話品質。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:962:    <string name="permdesc_manageProfileAndDeviceOwners">允許應用程式設定個人資料擁有者和裝置擁有者。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:963:    <string name="permdesc_modifyAudioSettings">允許應用程式修改全域音訊設定，例如音量和用來輸出的喇叭。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:964:    <string name="permdesc_modifyNetworkAccounting">允許應用程式修改應用程式網路使用量的計算方式 (不建議一般應用程式使用)。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:965:    <string name="permdesc_nfc">允許應用程式與近距離無線通訊 (NFC) 電子感應標籤、卡片及感應器進行通訊。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:966:    <string name="permdesc_persistentActivity">允許應用程式的部分內容常駐在記憶體中。這項設定可能會限制其他應用程式可用的記憶體，並拖慢平板電腦運作速度。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:967:    <string name="permdesc_processOutgoingCalls">允許應用程式在撥打電話期間查看撥出的電話號碼，並可選擇改撥其他號碼或中斷通話。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:968:    <string name="permdesc_readCalendar">這個應用程式可讀取所有儲存在平板電腦上的日曆活動資訊，以及共用或儲存日曆資料。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:969:    <string name="permdesc_readCallLog">這個應用程式可讀取通話記錄。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:970:    <string name="permdesc_readCellBroadcasts">允許應用程式讀取你裝置收到的區域廣播訊息。某些地點會發出區域廣播警示，警告你有緊急狀況發生。請注意，惡意應用程式可能會在裝置收到緊急區域廣播時，干擾裝置的效能或運作。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:971:    <string name="permdesc_readContacts">允許應用程式讀取平板電腦上儲存的聯絡人資料，包括你與特定聯絡人通話、傳送電子郵件或使用其他通訊方式的互動頻率。這項權限可讓應用程式儲存你的聯絡人資料，惡意應用程式也可能私自共用聯絡人資料。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:972:    <string name="permdesc_readHistoryBookmarks">允許應用程式讀取瀏覽器造訪過的所有網址記錄，以及瀏覽器的所有書籤。注意：這項權限不適用於第三方瀏覽器或其他具備網頁瀏覽功能的應用程式。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:973:    <string name="permdesc_readInstallSessions">允許應用程式讀取安裝工作階段。應用程式將可查看目前的套件安裝詳細資料。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:974:    <string name="permdesc_readNetworkUsageHistory">允許應用程式讀取特定網路和應用程式的網路使用記錄。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:975:    <string name="permdesc_readPhoneNumbers">允許應用程式存取裝置上的電話號碼資料。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:976:    <string name="permdesc_readPhoneState">允許應用程式使用裝置的電話功能。這項權限可讓應用程式判讀手機號碼和裝置 ID、是否正在通話中，以及所撥打的對方號碼。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:977:    <string name="permdesc_readSms">這個應用程式可讀取所有儲存在平板電腦上的簡訊。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:978:    <string name="permdesc_readSyncSettings">允許應用程式讀取帳戶的同步處理設定，例如判斷「使用者」應用程式是否和某個帳戶進行同步處理。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:979:    <string name="permdesc_readSyncStats">允許應用程式讀取帳戶的同步處理統計資料，包括同步處理活動記錄，以及同步處理的資料量。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:980:    <string name="permdesc_receiveBootCompleted">允許應用程式在系統完成開機程序後立即自行啟動。這會增加平板電腦的開機時間，而且會因為系統一直執行該應用程式導致平板電腦的整體運作速度變慢。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:981:    <string name="permdesc_receiveMms">允許應用程式接收和處理多媒體訊息。這項設定可讓應用程式監控傳送至你裝置的訊息，或在你閱讀訊息前擅自刪除訊息。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:982:    <string name="permdesc_receiveSms">允許應用程式接收和處理簡訊。這項設定可讓應用程式監控傳送至你裝置的訊息，或在你閱讀訊息前擅自刪除訊息。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:983:    <string name="permdesc_receiveWapPush">允許應用程式接收和處理 WAP 訊息。這項權限也能讓應用程式監控訊息，或在你閱讀訊息前擅自刪除訊息。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:984:    <string name="permdesc_recordAudio">這個應用程式隨時可使用麥克風錄音。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:985:    <string name="permdesc_register_call_provider">允許應用程式註冊新的電信連線。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:986:    <string name="permdesc_register_sim_subscription">允許應用程式註冊新的電信 SIM 卡連線。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:987:    <string name="permdesc_removeDrmCertificates">允許應用程式移除 DRM 憑證 (一般應用程式並不需要)。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:988:    <string name="permdesc_reorderTasks">允許應用程式將工作移至前景或背景。應用程式可以自行處理，不待你操作。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:989:    <string name="permdesc_requestDeletePackages">允許應用程式要求刪除套件。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:990:    <string name="permdesc_requestIgnoreBatteryOptimizations">允許應用程式要求權限，以便忽略針對該應用程式的電池效能最佳化設定。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:991:    <string name="permdesc_requestInstallPackages">允許應用程式要求安裝套件。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:992:    <string name="permdesc_route_media_output">允許應用程式將媒體輸出轉送至其他外部裝置。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:993:    <string name="permdesc_runInBackground">這個應用程式可在背景執行，這樣可能導致耗電速度加快。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:994:    <string name="permdesc_sdcardRead">允許應用程式讀取 SD 卡的內容。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:995:    <string name="permdesc_sdcardWrite">允許應用程式寫入 SD 卡。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:996:    <string name="permdesc_sendSms">允許應用程式傳送簡訊，但可能產生非預期的費用。惡意應用程式可能利用此功能擅自傳送簡訊，增加你不必要的額外支出。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:997:    <string name="permdesc_setAlarm">允許應用程式在安裝的鬧鐘應用程式中設定鬧鐘，某些鬧鐘應用程式可能無法執行這項功能。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:998:    <string name="permdesc_setInputCalibration">允許應用程式修改觸控螢幕的校正參數 (一般應用程式並不需要)。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:999:    <string name="permdesc_setTimeZone">允許應用程式變更平板電腦的時區。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1000:    <string name="permdesc_setWallpaper">允許應用程式設定系統桌布。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1001:    <string name="permdesc_setWallpaperHints">允許應用程式設定系統桌布大小的提示。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1002:    <string name="permdesc_sim_communication">允許應用程式傳送指令到 SIM 卡。這麼做非常危險。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1003:    <string name="permdesc_statusBar">允許應用程式停用狀態列，並可新增或移除系統圖示。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1004:    <string name="permdesc_statusBarService">允許應用程式以狀態列顯示。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1005:    <string name="permdesc_subscribedFeedsRead">允許應用程式取得目前已同步處理的資訊提供詳細資料。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1006:    <string name="permdesc_systemAlertWindow">這個應用程式可顯示在其他應用程式上方或畫面中的其他位置。你可能會無法照常使用應用程式，且其他應用程式的顯示方式可能會受到影響。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1007:    <string name="permdesc_transmitIr">允許應用程式使用平板電腦的紅外線傳送器。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1008:    <string name="permdesc_uninstall_shortcut">允許應用程式自動移除主螢幕捷徑。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1009:    <string name="permdesc_useBiometric">允許應用程式使用生物特徵硬體進行驗證</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1010:    <string name="permdesc_useDataInBackground">這個應用程式可在背景使用行動數據連線，這樣可能導致數據用量增加。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1011:    <string name="permdesc_useFingerprint">允許應用程式使用指紋硬體進行驗證</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1012:    <string name="permdesc_use_sip">允許應用程式撥打及接聽 SIP 通話。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1013:    <string name="permdesc_vibrate">允許應用程式控制震動。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1014:    <string name="permdesc_wakeLock">允許應用程式防止平板電腦進入休眠狀態。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1015:    <string name="permdesc_writeCalendar">這個應用程式可在平板電腦上新增、移除或變更日曆活動。提醒你，這個應用程式可能會以日曆擁有者的名義傳送訊息，或是在不通知日曆擁有者的情況下變更活動內容。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1016:    <string name="permdesc_writeCallLog">允許應用程式修改平板電腦的通話記錄，包括來電和已撥電話相關資料。請注意，惡意應用程式可能濫用此功能刪除或修改你的通話記錄。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1017:    <string name="permdesc_writeContacts">允許應用程式讀取平板電腦上儲存的聯絡人資料，包括你與特定聯絡人通話、傳送電子郵件或使用其他通訊方式的互動頻率。這項權限可讓應用程式刪除聯絡人資料。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1018:    <string name="permdesc_writeGeolocationPermissions">允許應用程式修改瀏覽器的地理位置權限。請注意，惡意應用程式可能利用此功能允許將你的位置資訊任意傳送給某些網站。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1019:    <string name="permdesc_writeHistoryBookmarks">允許應用程式修改平板電腦上儲存的瀏覽記錄或書籤。這項設定會讓應用程式具有清除或修改瀏覽資料的權限。注意：這項權限不適用於第三方瀏覽器或其他具備網頁瀏覽功能的應用程式。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1020:    <string name="permdesc_writeSettings">允許應用程式修改系統設定資料。請注意，惡意應用程式可能利用此功能破壞系統設定。</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml:1021:    <string name="permdesc_writeSyncSettings">允許應用程式修改帳戶的同步處理設定，例如讓「使用者」應用程式與某個帳戶進行同步處理。</string>

analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1092:    <string name="permdesc_acceptHandovers">Allows the app to continue a call which was started in another app.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1093:    <string name="permdesc_accessCoarseLocation">This app can get your location based on network sources such as cell towers and Wi-Fi networks. These location services must be turned on and available on your tablet for the app to be able to use them.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1094:    <string name="permdesc_accessDrmCertificates">Allows an application to provision and use DRM certficates. Should never be needed for normal apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1095:    <string name="permdesc_accessFineLocation">This app can get your location based on GPS or network location sources such as cell towers and Wi-Fi networks. These location services must be turned on and available on your phone for the app to be able to use them. This may increase battery consumption.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1096:    <string name="permdesc_accessImsCallService">Allows the app to use the IMS service to make calls without your intervention.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1097:    <string name="permdesc_accessLocationExtraCommands">Allows the app to access extra location provider commands. This may allow the app to interfere with the operation of the GPS or other location sources.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1098:    <string name="permdesc_accessNetworkConditions">Allows an application to listen for observations on network conditions. Should never be needed for normal apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1099:    <string name="permdesc_accessNetworkState">Allows the app to view information about network connections such as which networks exist and are connected.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1100:    <string name="permdesc_accessNotifications">Allows the app to retrieve, examine, and clear notifications, including those posted by other apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1101:    <string name="permdesc_accessWifiState">Allows the app to view information about Wi-Fi networking, such as whether Wi-Fi is enabled and name of connected Wi-Fi devices.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1102:    <string name="permdesc_accessWimaxState">Allows the app to determine whether WiMAX is enabled and information about any WiMAX networks that are connected.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1103:    <string name="permdesc_access_notification_policy">Allows the app to read and write Do Not Disturb configuration.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1104:    <string name="permdesc_addVoicemail">Allows the app to add messages to your voicemail inbox.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1105:    <string name="permdesc_answerPhoneCalls">Allows the app to answer an incoming phone call.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1106:    <string name="permdesc_bindCarrierMessagingService">Allows the holder to bind to the top-level interface of a carrier messaging service. Should never be needed for normal apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1107:    <string name="permdesc_bindCarrierServices">Allows the holder to bind to carrier services. Should never be needed for normal apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1108:    <string name="permdesc_bindConditionProviderService">Allows the holder to bind to the top-level interface of a condition provider service. Should never be needed for normal apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1109:    <string name="permdesc_bindDreamService">Allows the holder to bind to the top-level interface of a dream service. Should never be needed for normal apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1110:    <string name="permdesc_bindNotificationListenerService">Allows the holder to bind to the top-level interface of a notification listener service. Should never be needed for normal apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1111:    <string name="permdesc_bind_connection_service">Allows the app to interact with telephony services to make/receive calls.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1112:    <string name="permdesc_bind_incall_service">Allows the app to control when and how the user sees the in-call screen.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1113:    <string name="permdesc_bluetooth">Allows the app to view the configuration of Bluetooth on the tablet, and to make and accept connections with paired devices.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1114:    <string name="permdesc_bluetoothAdmin">Allows the app to configure the local Bluetooth tablet, and to discover and pair with remote devices.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1115:    <string name="permdesc_bodySensors">Allows the app to access data from sensors that monitor your physical condition, such as your heart rate.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1116:    <string name="permdesc_broadcastSticky">Allows the app to send sticky broadcasts, which remain after the broadcast ends. Excessive use may make the tablet slow or unstable by causing it to use too much memory.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1117:    <string name="permdesc_callPhone">"Allows the app to call phone numbers without your intervention. This may result in unexpected charges or calls. Note that this doesn't allow the app to call emergency numbers. Malicious apps may cost you money by making calls without your confirmation."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1118:    <string name="permdesc_camera">This app can take pictures and record videos using the camera at any time.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1119:    <string name="permdesc_changeNetworkState">Allows the app to change the state of network connectivity.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1120:    <string name="permdesc_changeTetherState">Allows the app to change the state of tethered network connectivity.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1121:    <string name="permdesc_changeWifiMulticastState">Allows the app to receive packets sent to all devices on a Wi-Fi network using multicast addresses, not just your tablet. It uses more power than the non-multicast mode.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1122:    <string name="permdesc_changeWifiState">Allows the app to connect to and disconnect from Wi-Fi access points and to make changes to device configuration for Wi-Fi networks.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1123:    <string name="permdesc_changeWimaxState">Allows the app to connect the tablet to and disconnect the tablet from WiMAX networks.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1124:    <string name="permdesc_connection_manager">Allows the app to manage telecom connections.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1125:    <string name="permdesc_control_incall_experience">Allows the app to provide an in-call user experience.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1126:    <string name="permdesc_createNetworkSockets">Allows the app to create network sockets and use custom network protocols. The browser and other applications provide means to send data to the internet, so this permission is not required to send data to the internet.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1127:    <string name="permdesc_disableKeyguard">Allows the app to disable the keylock and any associated password security. For example, the phone disables the keylock when receiving an incoming phone call, then re-enables the keylock when the call is finished.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1128:    <string name="permdesc_enableCarMode">Allows the app to enable the car mode.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1129:    <string name="permdesc_expandStatusBar">Allows the app to expand or collapse the status bar.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1130:    <string name="permdesc_foregroundService">Allows the app to make use of foreground services.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1131:    <string name="permdesc_getAccounts">Allows the app to get the list of accounts known by the tablet. This may include any accounts created by applications you have installed.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1132:    <string name="permdesc_getPackageSize">Allows the app to retrieve its code, data, and cache sizes</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1133:    <string name="permdesc_getTasks">Allows the app to retrieve information about currently and recently running tasks. This may allow the app to discover information about which applications are used on the device.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1134:    <string name="permdesc_handoverStatus">Allows this application to receive information about current Android Beam transfers</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1135:    <string name="permdesc_install_shortcut">Allows an application to add Homescreen shortcuts without user intervention.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1136:    <string name="permdesc_invokeCarrierSetup">Allows the holder to invoke the carrier-provided configuration app. Should never be needed for normal apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1137:    <string name="permdesc_killBackgroundProcesses">Allows the app to end background processes of other apps. This may cause other apps to stop running.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1138:    <string name="permdesc_manageFingerprint">Allows the app to invoke methods to add and delete fingerprint templates for use.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1139:    <string name="permdesc_manageNetworkPolicy">Allows the app to manage network policies and define app-specific rules.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1140:    <string name="permdesc_manageOwnCalls">Allows the app to route its calls through the system in order to improve the calling experience.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1141:    <string name="permdesc_manageProfileAndDeviceOwners">Allows apps to set the profile owners and the device owner.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1142:    <string name="permdesc_modifyAudioSettings">Allows the app to modify global audio settings such as volume and which speaker is used for output.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1143:    <string name="permdesc_modifyNetworkAccounting">Allows the app to modify how network usage is accounted against apps. Not for use by normal apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1144:    <string name="permdesc_nfc">Allows the app to communicate with Near Field Communication (NFC) tags, cards, and readers.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1145:    <string name="permdesc_persistentActivity">Allows the app to make parts of itself persistent in memory. This can limit memory available to other apps slowing down the tablet.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1146:    <string name="permdesc_processOutgoingCalls">Allows the app to see the number being dialed during an outgoing call with the option to redirect the call to a different number or abort the call altogether.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1147:    <string name="permdesc_readCalendar">This app can read all calendar events stored on your tablet and share or save your calendar data.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1148:    <string name="permdesc_readCallLog">This app can read your call history.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1149:    <string name="permdesc_readCellBroadcasts">Allows the app to read cell broadcast messages received by your device. Cell broadcast alerts are delivered in some locations to warn you of emergency situations. Malicious apps may interfere with the performance or operation of your device when an emergency cell broadcast is received.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1150:    <string name="permdesc_readContacts">"Allows the app to read data about your contacts stored on your tablet, including the frequency with which you've called, emailed, or communicated in other ways with specific individuals. This permission allows apps to save your contact data, and malicious apps may share contact data without your knowledge."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1151:    <string name="permdesc_readHistoryBookmarks">"Allows the app to read the history of all URLs that the Browser has visited, and all of the Browser's bookmarks. Note: this permission may not be enforced by third-party browsers or other applications with web browsing capabilities."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1152:    <string name="permdesc_readInstallSessions">Allows an application to read install sessions. This allows it to see details about active package installations.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1153:    <string name="permdesc_readNetworkUsageHistory">Allows the app to read historical network usage for specific networks and apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1154:    <string name="permdesc_readPhoneNumbers">Allows the app to access the phone numbers of the device.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1155:    <string name="permdesc_readPhoneState">Allows the app to access the phone features of the device. This permission allows the app to determine the phone number and device IDs, whether a call is active, and the remote number connected by a call.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1156:    <string name="permdesc_readSms">This app can read all SMS (text) messages stored on your tablet.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1157:    <string name="permdesc_readSyncSettings">Allows the app to read the sync settings for an account. For example, this can determine whether the People app is synced with an account.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1158:    <string name="permdesc_readSyncStats">Allows an app to read the sync stats for an account, including the history of sync events and how much data is synced.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1159:    <string name="permdesc_receiveBootCompleted">Allows the app to have itself started as soon as the system has finished booting. This can make it take longer to start the tablet and allow the app to slow down the overall tablet by always running.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1160:    <string name="permdesc_receiveMms">Allows the app to receive and process MMS messages. This means the app could monitor or delete messages sent to your device without showing them to you.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1161:    <string name="permdesc_receiveSms">Allows the app to receive and process SMS messages. This means the app could monitor or delete messages sent to your device without showing them to you.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1162:    <string name="permdesc_receiveWapPush">Allows the app to receive and process WAP messages. This permission includes the ability to monitor or delete messages sent to you without showing them to you.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1163:    <string name="permdesc_recordAudio">This app can record audio using the microphone at any time.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1164:    <string name="permdesc_register_call_provider">Allows the app to register new telecom connections.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1165:    <string name="permdesc_register_sim_subscription">Allows the app to register new telecom SIM connections.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1166:    <string name="permdesc_removeDrmCertificates">Allows an application to remove DRM certficates. Should never be needed for normal apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1167:    <string name="permdesc_reorderTasks">Allows the app to move tasks to the foreground and background. The app may do this without your input.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1168:    <string name="permdesc_requestDeletePackages">Allows an application to request deletion of packages.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1169:    <string name="permdesc_requestIgnoreBatteryOptimizations">Allows an app to ask for permission to ignore battery optimizations for that app.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1170:    <string name="permdesc_requestInstallPackages">Allows an application to request installation of packages.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1171:    <string name="permdesc_route_media_output">Allows an application to route media output to other external devices.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1172:    <string name="permdesc_runInBackground">This app can run in the background. This may drain battery faster.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1173:    <string name="permdesc_sdcardRead">Allows the app to read the contents of your SD card.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1174:    <string name="permdesc_sdcardWrite">Allows the app to write to the SD card.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1175:    <string name="permdesc_sendSms">Allows the app to send SMS messages. This may result in unexpected charges. Malicious apps may cost you money by sending messages without your confirmation.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1176:    <string name="permdesc_setAlarm">Allows the app to set an alarm in an installed alarm clock app. Some alarm clock apps may not implement this feature.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1177:    <string name="permdesc_setInputCalibration">Allows the app to modify the calibration parameters of the touch screen. Should never be needed for normal apps.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1178:    <string name="permdesc_setTimeZone">"Allows the app to change the tablet's time zone."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1179:    <string name="permdesc_setWallpaper">Allows the app to set the system wallpaper.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1180:    <string name="permdesc_setWallpaperHints">Allows the app to set the system wallpaper size hints.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1181:    <string name="permdesc_sim_communication">Allows the app to send commands to the SIM. This is very dangerous.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1182:    <string name="permdesc_statusBar">Allows the app to disable the status bar or add and remove system icons.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1183:    <string name="permdesc_statusBarService">Allows the app to be the status bar.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1184:    <string name="permdesc_subscribedFeedsRead">Allows the app to get details about the currently synced feeds.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1185:    <string name="permdesc_systemAlertWindow">This app can appear on top of other apps or other parts of the screen. This may interfere with normal app usage and change the way that other apps appear.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1186:    <string name="permdesc_transmitIr">"Allows the app to use the tablet's infrared transmitter."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1187:    <string name="permdesc_uninstall_shortcut">Allows the application to remove Homescreen shortcuts without user intervention.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1188:    <string name="permdesc_useBiometric">Allows the app to use biometric hardware for authentication</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1189:    <string name="permdesc_useDataInBackground">This app can use data in the background. This may increase data usage.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1190:    <string name="permdesc_useFingerprint">Allows the app to use fingerprint hardware for authentication</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1191:    <string name="permdesc_use_sip">Allows the app to make and receive SIP calls.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1192:    <string name="permdesc_vibrate">Allows the app to control the vibrator.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1193:    <string name="permdesc_wakeLock">Allows the app to prevent the tablet from going to sleep.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1194:    <string name="permdesc_writeCalendar">This app can add, remove, or change calendar events on your tablet. This app can send messages that may appear to come from calendar owners, or change events without notifying their owners.</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1195:    <string name="permdesc_writeCallLog">"Allows the app to modify your tablet's call log, including data about incoming and outgoing calls. Malicious apps may use this to erase or modify your call log."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1196:    <string name="permdesc_writeContacts">"Allows the app to modify the data about your contacts stored on your tablet, including the frequency with which you've called, emailed, or communicated in other ways with specific contacts. This permission allows apps to delete contact data."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1197:    <string name="permdesc_writeGeolocationPermissions">"Allows the app to modify the Browser's geolocation permissions. Malicious apps may use this to allow sending location information to arbitrary web sites."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1198:    <string name="permdesc_writeHistoryBookmarks">"Allows the app to modify the Browser's history or bookmarks stored on your tablet. This may allow the app to erase or modify Browser data. Note: this permission may note be enforced by third-party browsers or other applications with web browsing capabilities."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1199:    <string name="permdesc_writeSettings">"Allows the app to modify the system's settings data. Malicious apps may corrupt your system's configuration."</string>
analysis/apktool/res/values/strings.xml:1200:    <string name="permdesc_writeSyncSettings">Allows an app to modify the sync settings for an account. For example, this can be used to enable sync of the People app with an account.</string>

## Notes and limitations

- framework-res.apk is primarily a compiled Android resource package; it normally does not contain application DEX code.
- Analysis focuses on resources, configuration qualifiers, themes, dimensions, booleans, arrays, layouts, drawables and framework identifiers.
- The decoded values are static resource definitions. Actual runtime values can be affected by overlays, device configuration, product/vendor framework changes and framework code.
- This report does not prove runtime behavior and does not modify or install the APK.
